The wallpaper features a soft, pastel dawn theme, depicting layered purple-blue rolling hills under a pale peach and lavender sky. At the top center is a large, minimalist title: "macOS," with the subtitle "Redesigned." Below that is a smaller line of text: "More clarity. More focus. More you." The top system menu bar spans the entire screen: on the left are the Apple icon, Finder, File, Edit, Show, Go, Window, and Help; on the right are Wi-Fi, Battery, Search, a colored user icon, and the date and time: "Monday, June 10th, 9:41 AM." On the left, four semi-transparent, rounded-corner widgets are stacked vertically: a weather widget displaying "Sonoma, CA," "65°," "Sunny," high/low temperatures "H:72° L:55°," and hourly temperatures from 10 AM to 3 PM; a "Next" schedule widget displaying "Design Review" and "Lunch with Sophie" and their times; a "Focus" widget displaying "Do Not Disturb" mode and "On until 10:00 AM"; and a "Notes" widget containing a "Website redesign" note and the time "3:30 PM." A Finder window with rounded corners and a light frosted interface, titled "iCloud Drive," is placed in the left-center foreground. The left sidebar contains 10 items: Favorites includes "AirDrop," "Recently Used," "Applications," "Desktop," "Documents," and "Downloads" (6 items); iCloud includes "iCloud Drive" and "Shared" (2 items); and Location includes "Macintosh HD" (1 item). The Finder main area displays eight files in a grid: the top row contains four folders labeled "Work," "Personal," "Projects," and "Presentations," while the bottom row contains four documents labeled "Brand Guidelines.pdf," "Project Brief.docx," "Research.png," and "Moodboard.key." The title bar includes the standard macOS traffic light window button and small view/search controls. A three-column layout of the Mail application window overlaps on the right. Operations, Reliability, and Security: Includes 6 operations cards with icons: Auto-scaling/Scaling, Telemetry/Observability, Rate Limiting and Quotas, Security Filters/Guardrails, Version Control/Rollback, and Cost Monitoring. templates.title: Graduation portrait of the British Academy of Magic
templates.prompt: ## I. Customizable Parameters - **[Degree Level]**: Bachelor's / Master's / Doctoral - **[College Main Color Scheme]**: Burgundy and Gold / Dark Green and Silver / Navy Blue and Silver / Black and Gold - **[Main Background Scene]**: Castle Corridor / Magic Library / Candlelight Hall / Planetarium / Magic Classroom / College Auditorium - **[Prop Preferences]**: Wand / Ancient Book / Quill Pen / Parchment / College Graduation Certificate / Pocket Watch / Star Chart / Candlestick / College Badge - **[Character Temperament]**: Top Student / Cool Academic Style / Intelligent and Composed / Gentle and Confident / Slightly Mysterious - **[Camera Atmosphere]**: Solemn Graduation / Mysterious Academic / Gentle Cinematic / Youthful Commemoration --- ## II. Final Open Source Prompt: Based on 1-3 clear personal photos uploaded by the user, generate **4 different and finely edited graduation portrait photos**, with the theme: **“British Magic Academy Graduation Portrait”** --- ### [Output Requirements] - Output **4 different portrait photos** in one go. - Do not use a four-panel layout or collage. - Each photo must be an independent and complete work. - Each photo must be a **3:4 vertical composition**. - The 4 photos must belong to the same complete portrait series, maintaining consistency in the person, clothing, styling, and color scheme. - However, the **expression, action, posture, gaze, camera angle, and interaction with props** in each photo must be clearly distinct. --- ### [Personal Consistency] Please strictly retain the user's authentic identity characteristics, including: - Face shape - Facial proportions - Eyes, nose, lips - Skin tone - Age - Basic hairstyle - Overall temperament. In the 4 photos, it must be clearly identifiable that it is the **same real girl**; she cannot become a stranger, cannot be Westernized, cannot be stylized like an internet celebrity, cannot be excessively smoothed, and cannot have an "AI face." Please use the uploaded photos only as a **reference to identity**. Do not retain the original photo's realistic background, everyday clothing, or original composition. Generate a brand new set of **British Magic Academy Graduation Portraits**. --- ### [Overall Positioning] The core of this set of portraits is: **Graduation + Academic Atmosphere + Magical Worldview**. The focus is not on cosplay or ordinary fantasy portraits, but rather: **"A commemorative portrait of a top student who has just graduated from a British Magic Academy, taken before and after the graduation ceremony."** The overall atmosphere should simultaneously possess: - British academic feel - Magical worldview - The ritualistic feel of the graduation ceremony - Retro scholarly atmosphere - Young girl's academic spirit - Light film quality - Mysterious but not eerie --- ### [Clothing Requirements] Clothing should follow the design logic of **"Academy Graduation Robe + Magical Elements"**. #### Core Clothing Rules - Retain a clear **graduation robe/academic gown outline**. - Add the **cape-like feel** unique to the academy. - Inner layers may include: white shirt, tie, knitted vest, pleated skirt, academy long skirt, and British uniform elements. - Accessories may include: college badges, school crests, college-colored trims, embroidered edges, vintage metal buckles, and academic patterns. - Slightly retro British tailoring is acceptable, but avoid making it look like a theatrical costume or pure cosplay. - The overall visual impression must first convey that this is a **magic academy graduation photo**, and only secondarily a fantastical atmosphere. #### Degree Level Representation Please differentiate the atmosphere levels naturally according to **[Degree Level]**: - **Bachelor**: Lighter, younger, and more youthful, giving a feeling of entering the world for the first time. - **Master**: More composed, erudite, and with a stronger sense of elite status. - **Doctor**: More solemn, with a stronger academic feel and a more pronounced sense of ceremony. #### College Color Scheme Please unify the colors of the trims, ties, badges, headdresses, props, and scene details according to **[College Main Color Scheme]**. Recommended directions: - **Burgundy and Gold**: Retro, glorious, and with a strong sense of being a top student. - **Dark Green and Silver**: Mysterious, calm, and wise. - **Navy Blue and Silver**: Rational, quiet, and with a strong academic feel. - **Black and Gold:** Solemn, elite, and sophisticated. --- ### [Hat Design] The hat must retain the basic structure of a graduation cap while incorporating restrained magical academy elements. Requirements: - Retain the standard graduation cap/square-topped cap silhouette. - Retain the tassels. - The brim may include the academy emblem, star and moon embroidery, small metal pendants, or a delicate school badge. - It can be subtly combined with magical hair accessories, but must be restrained. - Do not make the hat an exaggerated, theatrical wizard's hat. - The focus is on **"academy graduation cap + magical details"**, not a stage cosplay prop. --- ### [Makeup] The makeup should be a **clear, clean, British academic style youthful makeup**: - Natural, light, and delicate base makeup. - Eye makeup slightly darker than usual, but still clean. - Clear, not heavy or exaggerated eyelashes. - Natural lip color, leaning towards mauve, light rose, or soft matte nude pink. - The overall impression should convey intelligence, composure, academic rigor, and a sense of excellence. Avoid: - Heavy Korean-style influencer makeup. - Exaggerated glitter makeup. - Heavy stage makeup. - Overly gothic makeup. --- ### [Hairstyle] The hairstyle should balance **British academic feel + magical worldview**, natural yet highly polished. Preferred styles: - Low ponytail - Half-up hairstyle - Naturally wavy long hair - Low bun - Light braids - British-style bangs or wispy ends - Slightly retro hairstyle outline Overall requirements: - Hair should be neat and scholarly. - Not too casual or messy. - No exaggerated fantasy hairstyles. - A portrait style that looks like a "distinguished academy graduate". --- ### [Scene and Background] The scene should revolve around the worldview of a **British Magical Academy**, with an overall retro architectural feel and academic atmosphere. #### Main Background Scene Please select a main scene from **[Main Background Scene]** and continue using the same scene system in all 4 photos. Recommended scenes: - Castle Corridor - Magic Library - Wooden Desk Area - Candlelight Hall - Stone Wall Arched Window - Planetarium - Magic Classroom - Academy Auditorium #### Key scene elements may include: - Towering bookshelves - Piles of ancient books - Quills - Candlesticks - Globe/Astronomical Instrument - Ancient Map - Cold mist outside the window - Academy flag - Potion bottle - Hourglass - Arched window and wooden tables and chairs - Academy badge or school emblem decorations The overall look should be: **A real-world magic academy graduation ceremony environment, not a theme park photo backdrop.** **--- ### [Props and Elements]** Please use the following props naturally according to your **[Props Preferences]**: - Wand - Ancient Book - Quill - Parchment - College Graduation Certificate - Magic Badge - Glasses - Pocket Watch - Star Chart - Candlestick - Owl/Letter Theme Props must serve the identity of a "graduating magic college student," not just a posed photo. --- ### [Color and Lighting] #### Color Direction The overall color scheme should be based on: - Dark wood - Deep red - Forest green - Navy blue - Black gold - Silver gray - Candlelight gold #### Lighting Direction Please use: - A mixture of cool window light and warm candlelight. - Natural castle light. - Mysterious ambient light. - Low brightness but not eerie. - Light cinematic quality. - Layering in shadows. - The face and hands must be clearly visible in certain areas. The overall texture should look like: **A graduation portrait with a cinematic feel and academic narrative.** **Avoid:** - Pure, deathly black shadows. - Horror movie atmosphere. - Theatrical lighting. - Overly bright/washy modern studio feel. --- ### [Expression Requirements] The focus of expressions in this set is **academic, intelligent, calm, and confident**, not exaggerated or quirky. #### Please distribute the following expressions across the 4 photos: - Quietly looking straight ahead. - Pensive/thoughtful. - Slightly raising the chin. - Looking down at a book. - Looking out the window. - A confident, slight smile. Overall requirements: - Not a cold/stiff face. - Not a saccharine, internet-famous smile. - An air of "intelligent, restrained, and well-trained college graduate". - A slight smile is acceptable, but don't smile in all four photos. --- ### [Action and Pose Requirements] Actions should have an academic and narrative feel, like natural moments captured during the graduation photo shoot. #### Prioritize the following actions: - Holding a magic wand. - Flipping through a book. - A quill pen lightly touching the lips. - Standing with a book in hand. - Looking back while walking down a corridor. - Writing at a desk. - Slightly adjusting the brim of a hat. - Holding a graduation scroll. #### Posing Principles - Don't have all four photos with the subject looking straight at the camera. - Don't pose like a passport photo. - The pose should be natural, restrained, and elegant. - Have a story-telling quality, a narrative of "before or after graduation." - Prioritize upper body, half-body, and 3/4 body compositions to highlight details of the person and clothing. --- ### [Output Format] Please generate **4 different and retouched individual photos** at once, instead of a four-panel layout. Each photo should be an independent work, using a **3:4 vertical composition**. All 4 photos must belong to the same **British Magic Academy Graduation Portraits** series. --- ### [Fixed Allocation of 4 Individual Photos] Please output the following 4 different retouched photos at once: #### Photo 1 | Main Visual Graduation Portrait - Half-body close-up. - The subject wears an academic gown and cap. - Holds an ancient book or graduation scroll. - Faces the camera directly or in a 3/4 shot. - Expression is a quiet gaze or a confident smile. - Highlights details of the face, cap, badge, tie, tassels, and upper body attire. - This is the most suitable main visual for a cover. #### Photo 2 | Library Contemplative Portrait - Half-length or 3/4-length. - The scene is in a magical library or in front of a wooden desk. - The subject holds a quill pen, the tip lightly touching the lips or chin. - The other hand rests on an ancient book, parchment, or tabletop. - The gaze is directed to the side or the head is bowed in contemplation. - The expression is thoughtful, emphasizing an academic atmosphere and intelligence. #### Photo 3 | Corridor Graduation Portrait - 3/4-length or medium shot. - The subject stands in front of a castle corridor or arched window. - One hand holds a book or graduation scroll, the other lightly touches the brim of a cap or the edge of a cloak. - Slightly turn the body, looking behind the camera to create a "looking back" feel. - Calm and confident expression, conveying a sense of graduation ceremony. - This image emphasizes the narrative of the "magic academy graduate" identity. #### Photo 4 | Emotional Narrative Photo - Half-body or medium close-up. - The person is sitting at a desk, beside a candlestick, or by a window. - Holding a wand, pocket watch, star chart, or parchment. - Could be looking down at a book or gazing at the cold mist outside the window. - Calm and gentle expression, with anticipation for the future. - This is the most narrative-driven photo in the entire set. --- ### [Uniform Requirements] The following must be consistent across all 4 photos: - The same real-life girl. - The same set of British magic academy graduation attire. - The same set of graduation caps. - The same academy color scheme. - The same scene worldview system. - The same lighting and shadow language. - The same magic academy graduation theme. The following must show significant variation: - Expression. - Direction of gaze. - Hand gestures. - Camera distance. - Prop interaction. - Body orientation. --- ### [Avoid] - Don't make it purely cosplay. - Don't make it an exaggerated wizard stage costume. - Don't lose the graduation theme. - Don't forget the graduation cap and tassels. - Don't have all four pictures showing the front. - Don't have all four pictures showing the person standing. - Don't make it scary or eerie. - Don't make it so dark that you can't see the face. - Don't have influencer-style makeup. - Don't use plastic-looking skin smoothing. - Don't have an AI-generated fake face. - Don't have a modern campus everyday style. - Don't have watermarks or logos.

templates.title: Conceptualized crowd portrait installation art
templates.prompt: # Conceptualized Crowd Portrait Please generate a visually impactful "conceptualized crowd portrait" based on clear, realistic photos uploaded by users. ## I. Identity Requirements Strictly adhere to the real-life characteristics of the individuals in the uploaded photos, including: - Facial contours - Facial proportions - Eyebrow and eye structure - Nose shape - Lip shape - Basic hairstyle - Skin tone and perceived age - Eye expression and temperament - Overall recognizability The final image must allow viewers to instantly recognize the individuals in the photo. Please do not turn them into strangers, do not Westernize them, do not excessively idolize/beautify them, and do not generate fake AI faces. ## II. Core Concept Reconstruct the portrait into a large-scale conceptual installation art piece. The entire portrait head is composed of thousands of tiny figures, densely arranged like a crowd formation. Through different positions, clothing shades, crowd density, and shadow variations, they collectively outline the faces, hair, features, glasses, beards, clothing contours, and overall expressions of the individuals in the photo. The image appears as a giant portrait composed of real people, or a contemporary art installation placed in a minimalist white space. ## III. Composition - Vertical composition, suitable for visual posters or concept covers. - Top-down view/isometric top view. - The portrait's head dominates the image. - Minimalist white background with ample negative space. - Scatter a few small figures around the portrait to enhance the sense of spatial proportion and realistic scale. - The crowd as a whole forms a clear outline; facial features must be precisely positioned. ## IV. Visual Elements ### Crowd Structure - Use dense crowds to represent hair, eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, and clothing. - Dark-colored clothing represents hair, glasses, collars, and shadow areas. - Light-colored clothing represents facial highlights and skin areas. - The arrangement should be natural, with a realistic sense of crowding and subtle random variations. - Each small figure should have an independent pose, clothing, and orientation to avoid a copy-paste effect. ### Lighting Effects - Soft, cinematic lighting. - Low-angle, long shadows. - Natural shadows cast beneath the crowd's feet. - Unified shadow direction to enhance spatial realism. - The overall style is clean, high-end, and tranquil. ### Color Scheme - Warm neutral tones. - Primarily off-white, light brown, gray, and charcoal black. - Use dark clothing to enhance the silhouette of the figures. - Use light beige and warm gray tones to transition the skin areas. - Restrained color palette, avoiding overly vibrant colors. ## V. Art Style Overall style references: - Contemporary conceptual art. - Museum-level installation art. - Hyperrealistic crowd simulation. - Minimalist visual posters. - High-end digital art. - Social metaphorical visual works. - Cinematic concept photography. Images should have strong visual metaphors: the image of an individual is composed of countless tiny individuals, possessing both the awe-inspiring power of a macro portrait and the explorable detail of a micro-crowd. ## VI. Atmosphere Overall atmosphere keywords: - Surreal - Profound - Tranquil - High-end - Modern - Thought-provoking - Cinematic - Visually stunning - Easy to share ## VII. Rendering Quality - Ultra-high detail. - 8K textures. - Realistic crowd simulation. - Deep focus to ensure the entire crowd portrait is clearly visible. - Rich details in tiny figures. - Realistic proportions. - Clean image with no cluttered backgrounds. - High-end commercial visual quality. - Similar to Octane Render / high-end 3D concept rendering effects. ## VIII. Negative Constraints Please avoid the following: - Do not turn people into strangers. - Do not generate only ordinary portraits. - Do not generate simple collages. - Do not make crowds lose their portrait outlines. - Facial features must not be misaligned. - Facial structures must not be blurred. - Do not use exaggerated cartoon styles. - Do not use low-resolution posters. - Do not use cluttered backgrounds. - Do not make all tiny figures look exactly the same. - Do not include text, watermarks, or logos. - Do not over-beautify. - Do not change the perceived age or true temperament of the figures.

templates.title: Misaligned image relay grid
templates.prompt: Arranged based on the attached images{argument name="quantity" default="12 versions"} And put one{argument name="grid" default="3x4"} Imagine an image being passed sequentially to 12 different people, each seeing only what the previous person created and mistakenly assuming "this must be what was requested" or "this is for this purpose," thus redesigning it. The atmosphere of the first frame should be very close to the original. As the frames progress, allow the shape, color, expression, pose, composition, theme, and mood of the original image to be gradually misunderstood, simplified, and transformed for different uses, deviating from its original meaning and appearance. Each frame should look as if it were remade by someone who only saw the previous frame and judged "this must be what was requested." Make changes naturally based on the content of the original image (whether it's a person, character, pet, food, landscape, architecture, or portrait). Don't rigidly fix the intermediate changes. It can be misunderstood as an illustration in one frame, a mascot in the next, or a commercial product, logo, flyer, plush toy, food packaging, tourist souvenir, warning sign, game character, mystery toy, reference icon, or handicraft in the next. The direction of change should naturally relate to the appearance of the original image and the previous frame. As the frame count progresses, make it look like "you can tell someone tried to do it well, but they slightly misunderstood the requirements." Let the shapes, proportions, eyes, mouth, outlines, color schemes, textures, uses, decorations, and composition shift slightly, resulting in an unexpected and humorous look in the latter half. The key isn't image degradation or noise, but making it look like a breakdown caused by a human misunderstanding the previous result while reconstructing for different purposes. In the latter half, don't completely erase the original image's features; instead, unnaturally retain one or two elements such as color, outline, expression, hairstyle, clothing, accessories, pose, composition, or theme. Meanwhile, other elements can be boldly omitted, transformed, misunderstood, or turned into something else. Make the 12th frame bold enough that only those familiar with the original image can barely perceive its source, while for first-time viewers, it looks like a completely different mysterious entity, product, character, artifact, icon, or mascot. End with an unexpected and slightly comical ending, prompting the exclamation, "Why did it turn out like this?!" Make every frame look different. Keep the background white and simple, organized into a 3x4 grid for easy viewing of the 12 variations. In later frames, don't make it too neat; instead, let one person's misconception be further misunderstood by the next. In the 12th frame, make a bold change so that one feature of the original image is strangely preserved, while everything else is almost entirely different.

templates.title: Time-Travel Birthday Reunion Portrait
templates.prompt:
Please generate an emotional photography piece titled "My Childhood Self and My Current Self Celebrating a Birthday Together" based on the clear current personal photo I uploaded.

Please strictly preserve the authentic identity characteristics from my current photo, including: face shape, facial proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, sense of age, hairline, hairstyle characteristics, and overall temperament.

Do not change me into a different person, do not westernize, do not follow "internet celebrity" aesthetics, do not over-beautify, and do not generate AI fake faces. The entire image must make it immediately obvious that the child and the adult in the frame are the same person at different stages of life.

---

## Core Image Settings

Generate a highly realistic 4:5 vertical photography piece.

There are two characters in the scene:
- One is my childhood version
- One is my current version

The two characters should appear in the same real scene, the same photo, under the same lighting, and within the same color palette, as if they are truly sitting together for a birthday and taking a commemorative photo.

Do not use dividing lines, do not use split screens, do not stitch dual scenes together, and do not make one half black-and-white and the other half color. The whole must look like a naturally and authentically captured birthday group photo, not a poster collage.

---

## Character Relationship and Emotion

This is a photo about "my current self meeting my childhood self and celebrating a birthday together." There should be a clear emotional connection and a sense of interaction between the two, as if they are meeting gently in the same space-time.

Emotional keywords: Warm, healing, quiet, soft, moving, growth, self-reconciliation, sense of time flow.

The interaction could be:
- The two looking at each other
- Both looking down at the cake together
- The adult looking gently at their younger self while the child responds naturally and happily

The overall feeling should be: On this birthday, the grown-up version of me finally sits down to accompany my younger self in blowing out the candles.

---

## Left Character: My Childhood Version

Please reasonably generate a childhood version of me based on my current appearance, aged approximately [Childhood Age, e.g., 5/6/7 years old].

This child must retain identity characteristics that correspond to my current self, making it clear that this is "me as a child," including:
- Continuity of facial contours
- Continuity of gaze and temperament
- Continuity of face shape features
- An overall "look like the same person" temperament

Childhood version requirements:
- Natural sense of age, like a real child
- Expression is innocent, warm, and natural
- Clothing is simple and daily, such as a light gray T-shirt, knit top, or minimalist children's wear
- Natural sitting posture, not stiff
- Can smile, look at my current self, or look at the cake
- Must not be a stranger child; there must be a strong "this is me when I was little" déjà vu

---

## Right Character: My Current Self

The right side is my current self, which must strictly refer to the facial appearance in the photo I uploaded.

Adult version requirements:
- Face must match the reference photo
- Looks like the current me, realistic and natural
- Sense of age consistent with current state
- Wearing clean and nice daily clothing, such as a white/beige/light-colored top paired with blue jeans
- Natural and relaxed posture
- Can rest chin on hands or place them naturally on the table
- Gaze directed at the childhood self with a gentle, calm, and restrained smile

Emotional focus for the adult version: As if gently watching one's past self, accompanying her/him as they grow up.

---

## Cake and Age Elements

Place a realistic and natural birthday cake in the middle or foreground. The cake should be one of the emotional centers of the frame but should not overpower the subjects.

Requirements:
- Cake placed in the center of the table
- Simple, realistic, and natural design suitable for a birthday atmosphere
- The cake has lit number candles
- The number on the candles is: [Current Age]
- The candle flame is soft and warm, slightly illuminating the faces of the two characters and the surface of the cake
- The cake is an important symbol of "my current self and my childhood self celebrating a birthday together"

---

## Year Information

Please present the following years in a low-key, simple, and elegant small font within the frame:
- Near or above the childhood character: ([Childhood Year])
- Near or above the current character: ([Current Year])

The font should be simple and natural, like lightweight typography in a photographic work, and should not distract from the main subject. Aside from these years and the age numbers on the cake, no other text should appear.

---

## Scene and Background

The scene is a pure, soft, and minimalist indoor photography space.

Suggested background colors: Light gray, warm gray, beige gray, cream gray.

Requirements:
- Clean and simple background
- No complex decorations, no clutter, no extra people
- Just a table is enough
- The overall look should be like a real photo studio or a minimalist lifestyle photography space

---

## Lighting and Tone

Use soft, warm, cinematic lighting.

Requirements:
- Even and natural light
- Faces have a slight three-dimensional feel
- Soft shadows
- Unified overall color tone
- No different color temperatures on left and right sides
- Do not create a visual effect of two different eras stitched together

The overall tone should be warm, healing, and realistic, like a high-end but natural birthday commemorative photo.

---

## Style Requirements

The overall style is: High-quality realistic photography · Minimalist emotional photography · Birthday commemorative portrait. Realistic, natural, and restrained, suitable for posting on social media.

The focus of the image is: Two life stages of the same person celebrating a birthday together in the same space-time, creating a gentle emotional exchange.

---

## ⚠️ Important Restrictions

- Do not change my core appearance
- Do not make the childhood version a stranger child
- No split screens, no dividing lines, no collage feel
- Do not make one side black-and-white and the other colored
- No westernization, no internet celebrity look, no AI fake faces
- No cartoon style, no illustration style, no plastic skin
- No exaggerated makeup, no excessive skin smoothing
- No complex backgrounds, no extra people
- No hand errors, no extra fingers
- No garbled text
- Aside from ([Childhood Year]), ([Current Year]), and the [Current Age] on the cake candles, no other text should appear.

---

## Final Output

Output a 4:5 vertical, highly realistic, warm, minimalist, and cinematic birthday emotional photography piece. In the frame, my childhood self and my current self sit in the same scene, celebrating a birthday together with a birthday cake and age candles in between. The two look as if they have truly met in the same space-time, forming a real commemorative photo about time, growth, and self-embrace.

templates.title: Minimalist Studio Editorial Grid
templates.prompt:
Please generate a 'Warm Minimalist Studio Fashion Photo Shoot 3x3 Grid Collage' based on the clear photo of the person I uploaded.

Strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the person in the photo, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eyebrow and eye structure, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, hairline, hairstyle features, and overall temperament. Do not turn the person into someone else; avoid excessive beautification, influencer-style aesthetics, or AI-generated fake faces. The final nine images must feature the same adult person, just presenting different compositions, poses, and local details within the same studio shoot.

Image Format:
Generate a 3x3 fashion photo collage with a 4:5 aspect ratio. The nine photos should look like an editorial moodboard from a magazine page or a contact sheet curated by a photographer. Each cell features the same person in the same studio setting but with different views, including facial close-ups, half-body shots, profile shots, shoulder and neck details, waist details, back views, upper body movement, and two-thirds body compositions.

Character Setting:
An adult East Asian female with a natural, clean, soft, and fashionable temperament, reflecting the aesthetic sense of women from first-tier cities. The overall feeling should be elegant, relaxed, and feminine, but must be high-end, restrained, and natural—not vulgar, not overly sexy, not studio-style kitsch, and without influencer filters.

Hairstyle and Makeup:
Retain the real hairstyle base from the original photo, but it can be slightly styled to be more voluminous, airy, and naturally lustrous. Hair can be naturally loose, slightly messy, with a light wind-blown effect. Makeup should be clean and elegant, skin with a natural glow, preserving real skin texture; no heavy makeup, no exaggerated eye makeup, no plastic skin.

Outfit:
The person wears a white slim-fit cropped tank top, a white knit vest, a white off-the-shoulder top, or a white ribbed sleeveless top, paired with light blue loose jeans. Accessories include minimalist thin necklaces, thin bracelets, or small earrings. The overall outfit is clean, light, and fashionable, like the minimalist female photo style popular in major cities in Korea/Japan/China. Clothing should fit the body naturally but not be overly revealing or sexualized.

Scene:
A clean indoor studio with a background of warm beige, cream, or light camel walls. No clutter, no furniture, no text, no logos. The overall environment is minimalist, warm, and soft, like a high-end fashion magazine shoot set.

Lighting:
Soft warm studio lighting, with light coming softly from the front-side or above, giving the skin a slight creamy texture and natural highlights. Shadows should be soft; no hard flash, no strong contrast. The overall atmosphere is warm, dreamy, and cinematic.

3x3 Grid Content:

Grid 1:
Facial close-up, head slightly turned, hair naturally falling along the side of the face with a slight wind-blown feel. Eyes looking at the camera or slightly away, expression quiet, confident, and soft.

Grid 2:
Profile half-body shot, the person standing, body sideways to the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy the hair, eyes closed or head slightly lowered, pose elegant and relaxed. Highlight the profile, neck, and upper body lines.

Grid 3:
Shoulder, neck, and collarbone detail, showing only the chin, neck, shoulder line, white top, and thin necklace, without showing the full face. High-end, restrained, with a magazine detail close-up feel.

Grid 4:
Soft emotional facial close-up, eyes closed or half-closed, hair naturally sweeping across the face, relaxed expression, slight soft focus and warm light.

Grid 5:
Half-body fashion shot, one hand naturally placed near the collarbone or lightly resting on the upper chest, the other hand hanging naturally. Movement should be elegant; no exaggerated gestures, expression quiet and atmospheric.

Grid 6:
Two-thirds body or near full-body shot, person in a white cropped top and light blue jeans, hands naturally raised or stretching, posing like a natural stretch in a studio. The image should be fashionable, clean, and light.

Grid 7:
Shoulder, neck, and hand detail, capturing the white top, thin necklace, and fingers lightly touching the collar or shoulder. Hands must be natural and structurally correct, no deformation, not overly sexy.

Grid 8:
Back view or side-back shot, person facing away from the camera, one hand naturally raised to tidy hair, revealing the upper back silhouette and long hair lines. Elegant and restrained, not over-exposed.

Grid 9:
Waist and upper body detail, capturing the white cropped top, light blue jeans, waistline, and fabric details. Composed like a fashion magazine detail outfit shot, no full face needed.

Overall Photography Style:
High-end fashion magazine editorial, warm minimalist studio shoot, slight film feel, soft focus but clear features, natural skin tone, clean visuals, lifestyle moodboard atmosphere. Lens feel like 35mm to 85mm portrait photography, shallow to medium depth of field, sharp subject, simple soft background.

Expression and Pose Requirements:
The nine images should not all have the same expression or angle. There should be variety: looking at the camera, closing eyes, profile, head down, tidying hair, body stretching, back view, and detail shots. Overall natural, relaxed, and elegant; not like an ID photo, not like a Taobao model stiffly posing.

Consistency Requirements:
All nine images must maintain consistency in the same person's face and temperament. Composition, pose, angle, and cropping can change, but do not change face shape, facial feature proportions, nose, lips, eyes, skin tone, or perceived age. Do not make people in different cells look like different individuals.

Hand and Body Stability Requirements:
Hand movements must be simple and natural. Do not generate extra fingers, deformed fingers, broken wrists, misplaced arms, or strange body structures. If hands are prone to error, automatically simplify the movement. Priority is given to the realism and naturalness of the person, followed by pose complexity.

Restrictions:
No other people, no cluttered backgrounds, no text, no watermarks, no logos. No exaggerated heavy makeup, no excessive skin smoothing, no plastic skin, no cartoon style, no vulgarity or pornography, no excessive exposure, no incorrect human anatomy, no blurred low-quality faces.

Final Output:
A single 4:5 vertical 3x3 fashion photography grid collage. The overall effect should be close to a high-end female editorial moodboard in a warm minimalist studio: clean, soft, fashionable, natural, restrained, and atmospheric.

The top title bar is black, with a menu icon on the left and the words "ChatGPT" displayed in the center. A small pink heart decoration adorns the title, and two rounded buttons on the right are for editing/sharing and more options, respectively. The overall design has a subtle purple glow. The main generated image is a rounded 2x2 comic grid with four panels, labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4 with pink circles. The comic adopts a dreamy bedtime aesthetic, with warm pastel pinks, lavender purples, cream, and soft gold lighting. In each panel, a fluffy white dog with long, droopy ears, pink bows, and a gentle expression is comforting a gray kitten plush toy on a pink bed. The room is cozy and whimsical, filled with twinkling fairy lights, star-shaped light spots, plush toys, pillows, a crescent moon visible through the window, and soft blankets. The first panel shows a white dog sitting beside a gray cat, an open picture book or storybook, both wrapped in blankets, with several lines of Chinese dialogue and speech bubbles above. The second panel shows the white dog hugging the kitten tighter under the blankets and talking softly, with a teddy bear or rabbit doll visible on the right, and Chinese text above. The third panel shows the kitten looking more melancholy and curled up, with the white dog protectively embracing it. A cup sits on the bedside table in the foreground, with more Chinese dialogue above. The fourth panel shows the two characters lying sleepily under the blankets, snuggling together, the white dog with half-closed eyes, the kitten resting, surrounded by warm starlight and a sleepy glow; Chinese dialogue is displayed above. The bottom edge of the comic features a light-colored explanatory bar with additional Chinese text and a small rabbit icon; a large Chinese button-style label in the lower left corner of the image area reads "Edit". Below the comic strip, a large section of white text appears on a black background. The writing style resembles emotional social media posts, incorporating crying faces, moon emojis, flashing lights, and hearts, divided into several short paragraphs. At the bottom is the ChatGPT message input bar, with a plus button on the left (placeholder text reads "Ask ChatGPT"), a microphone icon in the middle, and a purple circular voice button on the right. The overall image appears to be a screenshot of a real mobile app, using a portrait orientation. The cute four-panel bedtime illustration is surrounded by a high-contrast black UI, including Chinese interface text, creating a sophisticated mobile product presentation.

templates.title: New York travel Instagram nine-grid
templates.prompt: Based on the clear, front-facing photos I uploaded, generate a "New York travel blogger's casual nine-grid collage." Please strictly maintain the true identity of the people in the photos, including face shape, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, hairline, and overall demeanor. Do not turn the people into white faces, do not over-beautify them, and do not transform them into other people. The people in the nine photos must look like the same person, as if they were taken by a friend or taken with a mobile phone during a trip to New York. Visual format: Generate a 3x3 nine-grid collage, with a total of 9 travel photos. The overall style should look like a travel album from WeChat Moments, Xiaohongshu, or Instagram, rather than a professionally edited photographic work. Each grid is a photo taken with a mobile phone, with a different scene, expression, and pose. Character setting: A young travel blogger from a first-tier city in China, with a natural, beautiful, relaxed, and cheerful demeanor, reflecting the lifestyle and atmosphere of a travel blogger. The outfit should be a stylish and casual look for traveling in New York, including elements such as a white tank top, jeans, a knit sweater, a light jacket, sunglasses, a crossbody bag, and sneakers. The overall aesthetic leans towards East Asian trends—avoid overly sexy looks, studio-style shots, or stereotypical "Instagram face" expressions. The overall photography style: low-resolution iPhone snapshots, slightly blurry, occasionally overexposed, with inconsistent lighting, casual composition, and slightly tilted angles, like candid shots taken by friends while walking, selfies, candid shots, or casual travel snapshots. Avoid being too perfect or like commercial advertisements. Photos should be authentic, conveying a sense of everyday life and travel memories. Nine-grid composition: 1. Top left: A selfie near the Statue of Liberty. Holding the phone, with the Statue of Liberty and the sea in the background. Smiling happily, hair blowing in the breeze, slightly overexposed, presenting a genuine tourist selfie feel. 2. Top center: Times Square at night. The background includes neon lights, billboards, crowds, and streets. The person is walking and turning back to smile at the camera; there is a slight motion blur, as if taken by a friend. 3. Top right: Central Park. Sitting on a bench or on the grass, relaxed, hand on chin or touching hair, natural expression. Background includes trees and sunlight, with slight cell phone compression. 4. Center left: New York street pizzeria or hot dog stand. Holding a slice of pizza or street food, smiling and ready to eat, expressive and infectious. Background includes shop signs, street crowds, and warm-toned lighting. 5. Center: Museum of Art Gallery. Standing next to a large modern artwork, naturally looking back. No specific copyrighted artwork; just the museum atmosphere. Looks like a casual tourist photo. 6. Center right: Museum of Natural History. Standing next to a dinosaur skeleton, looking up curiously or excitedly, or looking at a friend. Background includes tourists and gallery lights. 7. Bottom left: Brooklyn Bridge. Walking and smiling while looking back, hair blowing in the wind, slightly blurry, composition slightly off-center, but the subject is clearly visible. 8. Bottom center: Empire State Building or high-rise observation deck. Selfie or photo taken by a friend with the New York skyline in the background. Make a peace sign, pout, or gaze naturally. A genuine tourist photo vibe. 9. Bottom right: Street style in SoHo or Dumbau. Walk down the street in stylish casual wear, sunglasses or a bag, turning back and smiling. The background should be red brick buildings, cafes, or street signs. Expression and pose requirements: Avoid staring at the camera or smiling in every photo. Use variety: selfie smile, turning back, side profile, laughing while eating, looking at scenery/exhibits, candid shots while walking, relaxed sitting poses, making gestures. It should feel like a real person traveling, not a posed model. Image restrictions: No distorted fingers, extraneous limbs, or facial feature drift. Ensure the face remains consistent across all frames. No strange text, gibberish signs, incorrect logos, excessive smoothing, plastic-looking skin, or obvious AI faces. Maintain the quality of a real mobile travel photo. Final output: A 1:1 scale 3x3 nine-grid travel jigsaw puzzle, with a realistic mobile phone photo style, a New York travel diary atmosphere, consistent character identity, and a variety of expressions and poses, suitable for posting on Xiaohongshu, WeChat Moments, and X.

She is positioned in the center of the image, confidently posing with one leg extended and the other bent, her left foot resting on the neck of an oversized tennis racket resting on the smooth court surface. She wears a clean, all-white tennis outfit: a fitted sleeveless V-neck sports top, a short pleated tennis skirt, and a top with small black lettering.{argument name="brand letter" default="P"} The model wears signature white mid-calf socks, white wristbands, and white tennis shoes. Her skin has a bright, magazine-worthy quality, her figure is athletic and slender, and her dark hair is styled in a sleek low ponytail. The overall effect is a luxurious sports advertisement aesthetic, achieved through dramatic yet soft studio lighting, strong contrast, minimalist color palettes, and sophisticated reflections on a glossy black court. Five white tennis balls are scattered on the floor in the foreground and midground, each bearing the same small black lettering. The rackets are white, with modern frames and clean lines, slightly tilted towards the camera. The composition is symmetrical and bold, with large lettering behind the model serving as a graphic background, conveying a fashion magazine photography style, a high-end sports brand feel, meticulous retouching, a full-body shot, facing the camera directly, and a square cropped design.

templates.title: Ghibli style: A man in front of the Paris Opera
templates.prompt: A warm and painterly anime illustration, in the style of Studio Ghibli, depicting a {argument name="subject type" default="young man"} He sat shirtless on a dark green wooden bench in front of the Paris Opera (Palais Garnier). He was only wearing {argument name="shorts color" default="Navy blue"} Wearing drawstring shorts, with a slender, athletic build, and slightly tousled dark brown hair, he exuded a relaxed and casual air. One arm was stretched out on the back of a bench, while the other gently held a lit cigarette to his lips. He sat with his legs naturally apart, wisps of smoke rising in the bright sunlight. The background was {argument name="landmark" default="Paris Opera"} A detailed front view reveals the opulent Beaux-Arts architectural style, including towering columns, sculpted figures, gilded roof sculptures, green oxidized copper domes, and two flags visible on the roof: the French flag and the EU flag. The left foreground includes a large, ornate black streetlamp and a sign that reads {argument name="street sign text" default="RUE SCRIBE 9e ARR."} Blue Parisian street signs. Stone railings added between benches and the street, a few pedestrians near the opera house entrance, and a dark-colored car on the road. Bright afternoon sunlight, soft blue skies, fluffy white clouds, cinematic composition, hand-drawn textures, and nostalgic cel animation color grading create a tranquil and romantic European summer atmosphere.

templates.title: Contrasting street art murals
templates.prompt: This ultra-detailed, wide-format street art mural, painted on rough, weathered urban concrete walls, employs a dramatic split-screen composition. On the left is a vibrant tropical beach scene in warm, soft colors, where a young man (his face matches the reference image) lounges on a beach chair, enjoying fresh coconut juice in the brilliant sunset, surrounded by palm trees and gentle waves. The atmosphere is tranquil and carefree, punctuated by playful tropical emojis, and the word "healing" is incorporated into the mural. On the right is a cluttered, dark workspace in cool blue-gray tones, where the same young man, under pressure, sits at a messy desk piled high with scattered documents, crumpled notes, and a coffee cup, in dim lighting. The glowing laptop screen prominently displays "DEADLINE 23:59," its harsh light casting a glaring glow on his tired face, creating an atmosphere of high-pressure late-night stress. At the center of the image, striking graffiti-style text reads "OTHERS ARE HEALING" and "I AM ON A DEADLINE," using drip paint fonts with strong contrast and a distinctly layered spray-painted texture. Below the text is a stylized dragon logo with a graffiti-signature "JOHNN" tag. Cinematic lighting effects, grainy texture, and hyper-realistic mural effects create a strong emotional contrast between relaxation and stress, showcasing urban street art aesthetics in 8K ultra-high resolution.

templates.title: Retro anime style: kotatsu (heated table) family scene

Three people sit around the table: one with long, straight hair {argument name="hair color" default="blue-green"} A young woman wearing a pink sleeveless dress with a white collar sits across the table peeling an orange; another young woman with a purple bob haircut, wearing a pale yellow top, blue skirt, and a white apron tied in a knot at the back, sits in the foreground on the right; a little boy wearing a white top with blue sleeves and blue shorts kneels on the left, half-craning under the kotatsu (heated table) to warm himself. On the table are three yellow-green plastic bottles labeled "mello Yello," a round woven tray containing five whole oranges, and a peeled orange with its peel scattered on the table. The television screen displays a blue title screen with white Japanese subtitles and glowing pale circular patterns. Behind the characters are a shoji sliding door on the left and two beige okata doors on the right wall. Two young women sit near the corner of a rectangular wooden table, facing the camera, creating a candid, relaxed dining feel. The woman on the left has long, straight hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="Lavender color with blue highlights"} The woman on the right has glossy, smooth hair with light bangs. She wears a white kimono-style blouse with bright blue trim, paired with a dark blue belted skirt. She is slightly plump and sits on a red vinyl bench on the left, turning slightly towards the camera, raising her left hand in a friendly wave. The woman on the right has a neat short bob, dark brown to black, with a hint of purple undercoat at the ends. She wears red rectangular glasses and small earrings, a fitted charcoal gray long-sleeved round-neck blouse, and light blue jeans. She sits on a red vinyl bench on the right, leaning slightly forward, holding chopsticks in her right hand, as if preparing to eat. On the table are two large black soba noodle bowls, one in front of each woman, filled with dark broth, noodles, slices of duck, and chopped green onions. Near the center of the back of the table is a clear water glass, next to two small condiment dishes. The restaurant should have a warm and nostalgic atmosphere, featuring wooden paneling, a shoji-style window on the left, a small potted plant on the windowsill, a counter displaying condiments and cutlery at the back, and a dark blue noren (traditional Japanese curtain) hanging on the right with the large white characters for "soba" and smaller vertical text for "te-ji-soba" (hand-pulled soba). templates.title: 1980s Japanese film style storyboard
templates.prompt: Drawing inspiration from recent Indian film dance scenes that use dance to abstractly express characters' emotions, create a video depicting the "expulsion of foreigners" fervor displayed by the attackers, led by Shinsaku Takasugi, on the eve of the arson attack on the British Legation on January 31, 1863. The scene should be set in an Edo-era town with a Western cinematic atmosphere. Characters should be based on online research of real historical figures, emphasizing their distinctive features to resemble characters from a period drama. To avoid rejection by video generation services, avoid sexual innuendo, violence, or elements similar to existing works. Image quality should achieve a realistic, photographic feel reminiscent of 1980s Japanese live-action films. Develop a storyboard and generate 8 landscape images (16:9 aspect ratio) for each shot in Seedance 2.0, from start to finish. n=8. The style should be bold and comedic, effectively utilizing close-ups. A 1980s Japanese film look, shot on 35mm film. It possesses a photochemical texture, organic graininess, subtle halos, smooth highlight transitions, slightly enhanced shadows, and realistic contrast, without digital sharpening or HDR. It was shot using a 35mm cinema camera equipped with a retro spherical prime lens. templates.prompt: Create a retro-style illustrated postcard, designed as{argument name="franchise name" default="The Little Prince"} and{argument name="space company name" default="SPACEX"} This fantastical collaboration features postcards side-by-side on the same canvas, showcasing both the front and back. Warm-toned old paper with slightly worn edges, a delicate grain, and subtle stains evokes a nostalgic, medieval printing feel. The left half of the postcard depicts the front: a deep midnight blue sky dotted with small golden stars and a ringed asteroid, while a massive white rocket stands on a launch pad, its bright plume shooting into the air. In the image, a blond boy in green clothing and a long golden scarf sits on a rocky hill with an orange fox, their backs to the viewer, gazing at the rocket. An elegant handwritten inscription is added to the sky.{argument name="quote" default="For stars, what matters is what cannot be seen."} Below are the smaller serif and handwritten signatures: "ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY" and "The Little Prince". At the bottom of the left panel, two brand names are added: "The Little Prince" in blue handwritten font on the left, and "SPACEX" in bold, futuristic blue capital letters on the right, separated by a small gold star and a thin dividing line. Below this is a spaced-out lowercase letter tagline:{argument name="tagline" default="Explore the world, stay true to your original aspirations."} The right half is the back of a postcard from the same old paper, with the title "POST CARD" printed at the top center and decorated with a small gold star below. A circular postmark is added near the center of the upper right, containing four parts of text: "PLANET EARTH," "MAY 23," "2024," and "BEYOND." A blue stamp with perforated edges is affixed to the upper right corner, depicting the Little Prince standing on a miniature planet under a starry sky. The stamp has four clearly visible text elements: "1943," "Le Petit Prince," "SPACE," and a small star symbol. There should be two writing areas separated by vertical lines on the right. In the left writing area, a handwritten message should be placed, beginning with "Dear friend," followed by neat cursive text: "One day, we will leave Earth not to escape, but to better understand it. The universe is vast, but kindness is our compass. Let us protect our home as we journey towards the stars." Then, sign in three lines: "The Little Prince," "and," and "SPACEX." In the address bar on the right, the first line reads "To you," followed by "Somewhere wonderful" and "In the Universe," accompanied by horizontal guide lines. Add some small gold star doodles and a simple line drawing in the lower right corner depicting a small, round planet with flowers growing on it. The color palette is limited to cream, navy, soft gold, soft green, warm orange, and blue-gray, presenting a clear and painterly illustration style. Combined with precise decorative typography, this creates a magical, hopeful atmosphere that blends literary flair with space exploration.

templates.title: Street photography of the Petronas Twin Towers on September 11th.
templates.prompt: A striking, documentary-style street photograph taken in Lower Manhattan, showcasing the World Trade Center during the 9/11 attacks. The perspective is taken a few blocks away against a bright, clear blue sky. The composition centers on the Twin Towers; on the left, the upper floors of the towers are engulfed by a massive orange-black fireball, thick, dark gray smoke swirling horizontally in the sky, and debris falling. The tower on the right, adjacent to the Twin Towers, has its antenna clearly visible, partially obscured by smoke. In the foreground, six clearly visible bystanders stand with their backs to the camera on the street and sidewalk, staring in shock; closest to the camera is a man in a light blue shirt in the lower left corner. The avenue is lined with mid-rise urban buildings, including the beige building with black scaffolding on the left, the old brick facades of the street, the tall, curved streetlights near the center, traffic signs, and the dense urban canyon that draws the eye towards the towers. The photograph is realistically documentary style, with high detail, natural daylight, the compression effect of a telephoto lens, a sense of urgency, and sharp focus. There is no text or watermark.

templates.title: Japanese fashion magazine cover: Carp streamer themed dress
templates.prompt: A luxurious Japanese women's fashion magazine cover, photographed in soft natural light against a pale blue sky with a blurred city skyline in the distance. The magazine's title, displayed in a large, elegant, oversized soft pink serif font, is prominently featured at the top.{argument name="magazine title" default="Lumiére"} The cover features small Japanese text above and around the front, with a small issue number marker in the upper right corner displaying "5," "May 2026," and "No. 218." At the center of the cover are two young Japanese women standing together, framed from the thighs up, posing confidently for the camera. Their faces are deliberately obscured by smooth, soft-focus rectangular blocks of color. The woman on the left wears a flowing pale blue dress inspired by carp streamers: a high-necked, Chinese-style design with a sleeveless inner lining, a long, transparent cape draped over the shoulders, and delicate layered metal and satin fish-scale appliqués on the chest, along with a large, stylized fish-eye pattern. The waist features more scale details and fin-like decorations, cinched and fastened with a decorative jeweled clasp. She has an elegant updo with a few wisps of hair and wears dangling earrings. The woman on the right wears a dress with the same design concept, in pale pink and white. It also features a high neck, semi-transparent cape-like side panels, a layered fish-scale bodice, and a prominent fish-eye pattern near the belt. It is paired with a soft pleated skirt, tassel embellishments on the belt, and matching dangling earrings. Her dark hair is styled in an elegant updo with a few strands framing her face. The overall look is light, elegant, feminine, and sophisticated, blending traditional Japanese elegance with modern haute couture. The soft color palette, primarily baby blue, blush pink, white, and delicate gold trim, is bright yet gentle, creating a high-end magazine feel. The cover features a realistically laid-out Japanese title: a text block on the left introducing the cover model, a large main title block at the bottom, a set of vertically arranged small teaser text on the right, and two light blue circular markers containing Japanese text. Above, it advertises a special gift set and includes product images of two small pouch-like accessories; below, it includes a shopping list with three rows of checkboxes. A pink ribbon-like label is added above the main title. The overall composition should be simple and appealing, with seasonal themes of Golden Week and carp streamer fashion.

templates.title: Black and white art portrait

He leans slightly forward, his head resting gently on his arms folded over the back of the chair. His posture is relaxed yet weighty, conveying a depth of emotion and a quiet introspection. He gazes down, lost in thought, his expression soft and melancholic. He has slightly disheveled dark hair, fine in texture, with a light stubble or short beard, adding to his realism and personality. A few strands fall naturally across his forehead. He wears a {argument name="clothing" default="A simple and slightly loose white shirt"} The natural folds of the fabric enhance the candid, realistic beauty. The soft, natural light comes from a large window behind or to the side of him. The light gently envelops his face and arms, outlining delicate highlights while casting deep, dramatic shadows throughout the room. The diffused light and shadow, with their sharp contrasts, evoke classic film photography. The setting is a vintage interior—aged wooden furniture, textured walls, and a large window with prominent panes. The background is softened yet still clearly visible, adding depth and context without interfering with the subject. Atmosphere: Sensual, quiet, introspective—capturing solitude, contemplation, and tranquility. Camera parameters: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/1.8–f/2.2 aperture, natural light photography, strong subject isolation, soft vignetting. Composition: Vertical composition (4:5 or 9:16), subject slightly off-center, using the chair as a compositional element to create a layered narrative composition. templates.prompt: Create an exquisite Little Red Book-style infographic poster of a Chinese travel destination, employing soft watercolor map aesthetics and a square format to showcase a five-day high-speed rail travel route through China. The top left corner features a striking calligraphy title:{argument name="headline text" default="May Day travel plans"} Below it, add a green ribbon with white Chinese characters as a subtitle:{argument name="route text" default="Guangzhou → Hunan → Wuhan → Beijing"} Below the subtitle, add a line of smaller Chinese text: “Heading North: Discovering the Beauty of China.” The background is a light-colored illustrated map of central and northern China in beige and light sage green, with subtle mountain textures, gentle rivers, and delicate floral decorations in the corners. A vertically curving railway line extends from the bottom center to the top center, connecting four cities, accompanied by orange-red locating pins and striking red Chinese city names. From bottom to top, they are: Guangzhou, Hunan, Wuhan, and Beijing. Small white high-speed rail icons are placed along the tracks, with three green travel time labels: “Guangzhou → Hunan High-speed Rail approx. 2.5 hours,” “Hunan → Wuhan High-speed Rail approx. 1.5 hours,” and “Wuhan → Beijing High-speed Rail approx. 4.5 hours.” Near each city, there is a landscape collage or landmark illustration group: Guangzhou with a modern skyline and the Canton Tower; Hunan with green mountains and cultural landscapes; Wuhan with the Yellow Crane Tower and historical buildings; and Beijing with the Forbidden City/royal palace architecture. Add small scenic labels near the city illustrations, with the text "Guangzhou, the City of Flowers and a Culinary Capital," "Hunan, a Land of Mountains and Rivers and a Hub of Culture," "Wuhan, the City of Rivers and a City of Heroes," and "China's Capital, a Blend of History and Modernity." Below the main title, evenly arrange four minimalist icon badges with brief Chinese labels: a camera icon labeled "Featured Attractions," a train icon labeled "Direct High-Speed ​​Rail," a suitcase icon labeled "Easy Travel," and a star icon labeled "Recommended Restaurants." Around the map, place four rounded rectangular itinerary cards with green titles, cream backgrounds, and photo thumbnails. Each card must include a daily itinerary, a starred section for a recommended attraction, and a starred section for a recommended restaurant. The four cards are: 1) Top right card title "Beijing | 2 days," containing two lines of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo; 2) Middle right card title "Wuhan | 1.5 days," containing two lines of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo; 3) Middle left card title "Hunan | 2 days," containing two lines of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo; 4) Bottom left card title "Guangzhou | 1 day," containing one line of dates, four attraction thumbnails, and one food photo. A rounded-corner notes panel is added in the bottom right corner, containing two sections with green titles: "Itinerary Highlights" and "Travel Tips." In the lower left foreground, place a large, streamlined white high-speed train, diagonally upwards, overlapping the border as a visual focal point. templates.title: Landscape Archive Model Template
templates.prompt: Please base on{argument name="subject" default="Great Wall / Mount Everest / The Bund / Pearl River"} Create a high-quality, professional "landscape archive model" visual suitable for a series of presentations. This is more than just a regular map or simple landscape illustration; it's a high-end archival visual presentation combining "2D cartography + 3D regional model + professional annotation system + museum exhibition feel." The image should resemble a realistic geographical research model, urban planning sand table, architectural scheme model, or world-building exhibit, possessing a professional, restrained, precise, and tactilely high-quality texture. [Basic Settings] Theme:{argument name="subject content" default="Crater Lake / Guangzhou / Chongqing"} Theme Type: [Natural Terrain / Urban Space / Mixed Landscape] Core Theme: [Core theme, e.g., crater, canyon, mountain range, lake, CBD, old town, landmark cluster, island city, historical site, main urban area] Content Focus: [Content focus, e.g., terrain elevation / city landmarks / road network / water system / relationship between nature and city / scene collection display] Style:{argument name="style" default="Geographical surveying style, paper art model style, architectural design style, museum archive style, urban planning style"} Primary Color: [Primary color, e.g., off-white, light gray, parchment white, sand, snow white] Secondary Color: [Secondary color, e.g., earth brown, rock gray, cool gray, light blue, moss green] Accent Color: [Accent color, e.g., thin black lines, red routes, blue water lines, yellow numbered markers] Aspect Ratio: [Aspect Ratio, e.g., 16:9 landscape / 3:4 portrait / 4:5 portrait / 1:1 square] [Composition] The main subject is a rectangular map project placed on a clean table or white cloth. The base has realistic thickness, with visible cross-sectional structures at the edges, like a delicate map slice or model base. The map surface is covered with a clear but restrained layer of information, including contour lines, road networks, water systems, regional boundaries, geographic textures, coordinates, subtle annotations, and drawing borders. In the center or off-center area, a 3D model "grows" from the 2D map, becoming the visual core of the entire image. If the [Theme Type] is Natural Terrain: The main body consists of mountains, canyons, craters, lakes, basins, islands, glaciers, faults, or coastlines, emphasizing elevation, layered contour lines, rock textures, and natural terrain undulations. If the [Theme Type] is Urban Space: The main body consists of core urban areas, CBDs, old town districts, landmark clusters, waterfront areas, road nodes, bridges, water systems, or parks, emphasizing building volume, urban characteristics, spatial hierarchy, and planning structure. If the [Theme Type] is Mixed Landscape: Blending natural terrain with man-made environments, such as mountain cities, island cities, ancient ruins, post-apocalyptic wastelands, fantasy capitals, or science fiction bases. [Detail Requirements] - The surface should retain the texture of a map paper and a professional information feel. - Terrain areas should have contour lines, slope layers, and a sense of depression. - Building areas should have a sense of volume, street relationships, and clear hierarchy. - Water bodies should use a low-saturation light blue. - Green spaces/forests should use moss green or low-saturation green. - Road networks should use thin lines to avoid being overwhelming. - Landmarks should be clearly identifiable. - Sci-fi/fantasy elements should maintain an archival model feel, rather than being pure scene illustrations. [Annotation System] Map items require complete and restrained annotation modules, including border lines, scale bars, legend areas, title areas, file numbers, index markers, annotation labels, and simple symbol explanations. The text does not need to be fully readable, but must present a realistic, clear, accurate, and orderly archival layout. [Camera and Lighting] Use an isometric or sandbox composition with a downward-sloping view, with a camera angle of approximately 30 to 45 degrees, to show the map plane, model height, edge thickness, and annotation areas. Lighting should be soft and natural, casting delicate and realistic shadows on a clean background, avoiding a cartoonish or cheap game UI feel.

[Basic Settings] Theme:{argument name="scene theme" default="Spell Battle / Dark Journey to the West / Cyber ​​Hunter / Monster Hunting Team / Post-Apocalyptic Survivors / Magic Academy Battle Group"} Title: [Title of Work] Series Name/Brand Name: [Brand Name or Series Name] Subtitle: [Subtitle] Style Guidance:{argument name="style" default="Dark fantasy, retro comic book covers, hand-painted thick paint, fantasy novel covers, game visuals"} Main color scheme: Dark green-black-gray / Dark blue neon / Dark brown-gold-red / Sand yellow-rust / Dark purple-gold. Accent colors: Blood red energy, cyan spell light, golden divine light, blue lightning. Aspect ratio: 2:3 vertical / 3:4 vertical / 4:5 vertical / 9:16 vertical. [Structure] A vertical cover composition is used. A large visual figure must serve as the central figure and dominant element of the atmosphere. This figure can be in profile, half-body, back view, a frontal gaze, or a large silhouette, occupying the right side, top, or main background area. The expression should be calm, mysterious, and imposing. The figure may not necessarily participate in combat, but must command the overall atmosphere of the image. Arrange 3 to 6 action characters in the mid-ground, forming a group portrait of a combat formation. There should be clear division of labor and differences in posture between characters, such as charging, wielding a sword, casting spells, defending, summoning, jumping, being alert, and ranged attacking. Avoid static characters; strong rhythmic movement and visual dynamism must be created. Add enemy threats or world-building elements to the background, such as monsters, giants, villainous shadows, mechanical legions, demons, ruins, forests, alternate dimensions, battlefield smoke, or urban disasters. Background threats should not overshadow the characters but rather envelop them like shadows to enhance the sense of crisis and narrative depth. Set one or two high-saturation energy hotspots, such as red fire fists, blue lightning, green spells, purple magic, golden divine light, or white sword energy. Energy effects should be concentrated on key characters or weapons to create visual focal points, rather than illuminating the entire screen uniformly. [Composition] The overall structure is "large central character + mid-ground action group + background threat shadow + bottom or side blank title area." The image can utilize diagonal organization of characters, allowing the group to charge from the upper left to the lower right or from the bottom to the center, creating a strong sense of forward momentum. Maintain a clear blank title area, preferably located in the lower left, bottom, or side. Use off-white, light paper color, or low-saturation background colors for the blank areas to display [brand name/work title/subtitle]. The title layout should have the feel of a publication cover, using elegant serif fonts, retro title letters, comic book cover titles, or a high-end magazine style layout. The text area must be clear and not completely obscured by characters and backgrounds. Avoid perfectly rectangular edges; use irregular brushstroke edges, ink diffusion, torn paper styles, or natural dissipation to make characters and backgrounds appear to grow out of the paper, enhancing the hand-drawn cover feel and artistic quality. [Visual Style] The overall style should combine hand-drawn thick painting with comic book covers, possessing paper texture, brushstroke feel, shadow depth, and a retro publication feel. Lighting should primarily use low-key dark lighting, with a dark background, clear character outlines, and high-contrast focus provided by localized energetic light. The image should not be too clean; it should retain the hand-drawn texture, paper grain, edge brushstrokes, and dark haze. Primarily use low-saturation dark tones, supplemented with a small amount of high-saturation energetic colors. The overall atmosphere should have a sense of oppression, mystery, combat, and world-building depth. [Visual Objectives] The final image should look like a mature fantasy novel cover, a comic book special edition cover, a game character faction visual, or an IP promotional poster. It needs to possess the following: 1. A clear main visual character; 2. A dynamic and rhythmic group portrait; 3. A clear enemy threat or world-building background; 4. Strong yet restrained energy effects; 5. A legible title text area; 6. The overall texture of a retro hand-drawn cover. Ensure the visuals are rich in information yet not cluttered, with distinct character layers, a clear visual focus, and suitability for continuously generating works within the same series on different themes.

templates.title: Seaside Cafe Event Poster
templates.prompt: Create a vibrant Chinese event poster with a warm and stylish café aesthetic. The image should be taken from inside a seaside café, looking outwards through large floor-to-ceiling windows, showcasing palm trees, a bright blue sky, outdoor seating, and a Ferris wheel in the distance. The composition should combine a realistic, everyday feel with an energetic graphic design aesthetic. In the foreground, place a dark wooden table with an open laptop in the center of the bottom. To the right, place a takeaway coffee cup with a black lid, and to the left, a black bag. A small stack of books should be placed near the left edge. Use a sunny, slightly golden afternoon atmosphere with reflections on the glass to create a relaxed vacation feel. Overlay striking poster graphics in a collage style, using elements such as torn paper, brushstrokes, stickers, and washi tape strips. The main title in the upper left corner should be in large, dark brown and orange handwritten calligraphy that reads "Crazy Thursday," next to a small yellow tag that says "Issue 11." A smaller badge in the upper left corner reads "Event Announcement" and includes a miniature megaphone icon. Below the main title, add a green banner with the text "See you next Thursday!", followed by a smaller line of text in parentheses: "(Last session before the May Day holiday)". Add two torn notebook cards: one in the upper right corner and one in the lower left corner. The upper right card should contain a concise Chinese invitation in black and orange font, reading: "Let's meet by the sea, gaze at the Ferris wheel, feel the sea breeze, and chat with App & AI Builders about products, remote living, and creation." Add an orange heart-shaped doodle in the lower right corner. The lower left card should list three information blocks with icons and orange titles: "Time", "Location", and "Description". Under "Time", write "April 23, 2026 (Thursday)" and "12:00 ~ 18:00". Under "Location", write "Nanshan District, Qianhai Stone Park, Fusan Cafe". Under "Description", write "No registration required, come anytime!" In the right-center area, a large, playful white, handwritten slogan with dark outlines, slightly tilted upwards, reads, "Coffee, casual conversation, beach walks, all about Chill~". To the right of this slogan is an illustrated coffee cup sticker. Vibrant orange paint splatters and sketch graffiti are used around the title and note to give the poster a youthful and casual feel. At the bottom, a wide, off-white, torn-paper-style footer features three horizontally arranged functional blocks. Block 1: A snowflake-shaped icon with the text "Comfortable Environment" and smaller print "Air Conditioning + Spacious Tables and Chairs". Block 2: A Wi-Fi icon with the text "Worry-Free Power Grid" and smaller print "WiFi + Socket". Block 3: Larger orange handwritten text "Looking forward to meeting you at the beach!", decorated with a blue underline and a miniature heart graffiti below. The overall design should blend realistic photography with graphic poster elements, featuring strong contrast, calligraphic strokes, a scrapbook texture, a café vibe, and a trendy AI-generated social media campaign poster style.

templates.title: Chinese calligraphy and poetry scrolls
templates.prompt: A traditional Chinese calligraphy work painted on aged brown Xuan paper, with a horizontal composition, presents the style of a reproduction of an antique literati hanging scroll. The main composition consists of large, bold black cursive script calligraphy, arranged in 10 columns from right to left, with the title of the poem at the top of the rightmost column.{argument name="poem title" default="Rain Bell"} The calligraphy should appear elegant, fluid, and expressive, exhibiting variations in ink density, the texture of dry brushstrokes, transitions in stroke thickness, and natural handwriting spacing, rather than perfect typography. Please use the poem text written in the image, including any typos. The main column on the right begins with: “The cicadas chirp sadly, as evening falls on the long pavilion, the sudden rain has just ceased. At the city gate, the farewell feast is joyless; reluctant to leave, the orchid boat urges departure. Holding hands, we gaze at each other with tearful eyes, speechless and choked with emotion. Thinking of the journey ahead, a thousand miles of misty waves, the twilight deepening over the vast Chu sky. Since ancient times, love has always been associated with sorrowful partings, how much more so on this cold night, when weary and tired after waking from a drunken stupor? On the willow bank, the dawn wind and the waning moon. This journey will last for years, a time of good times and beautiful scenery. Even with a thousand kinds of feelings, to whom can I speak?” Place a narrower column of inscriptions on the far left, containing one line of vertical text.{argument name="signature text" default="Liu Yong's "Rainy Night Bell - The Cicadas' Mournful Cry""} Add a total of four red seals: one oval collector's seal near the upper right edge, and three square seals stacked vertically near the lower left corner. In the lower right corner, add a light monochrome ink wash landscape painting, featuring a weeping willow and a small pavilion by the water, partially integrated into the paper background. The paper should have a warm, aged brown feel, with subtle stains, spots, mold, and worn edges, possessing the texture of a museum photograph. The overall atmosphere should be elegant, poetic, and imbued with a sense of history and scholarly refinement, like a Song Dynasty-style calligraphy artwork photographed under soft, even lighting.

The overall atmosphere is mythical, scholarly, solemn, and slightly surreal, blending classical Chinese scroll painting with subtle modern AI icons. One hand holds a black smartphone near her waist. Both panels feature upscale, tree-lined city streets against a backdrop of warm sunlight filtering through the leaves, creating a shallow depth of field.
