templates.title: Professional Trading Card Illustration
templates.prompt:
Please generate a high-quality trading card-style illustration.

[Reference]
Base it on the provided character image. (Do not refer to text in the image.) Maintain the character's face, outfit, features, and identity.

[Style]
Modern Japanese trading card game style. High definition, dynamic composition, dramatic lighting, vivid colors, sharp rendering. A high-end feel like hologram processing. Readable text and organized UI design.

[Layout (Fixed)]
A vertical card with the following composition:
- Top left: Rarity display (text)
- Directly below rarity: Attribute (icon + text)
- Center: Full body of the character (with effects based on abilities)
- Bottom left: Status section
- Bottom right: Skill/Special move description
- Bottom center: Character name (large and prominent)

[Text Elements]
- Name: {{★Input manually or auto-generate from appearance}}
- Attribute: Auto-generate from appearance
- Rarity: Auto-generate from appearance

[Status (Auto-generate 0-100 values and gauges for each item based on appearance)]
- Attack
  High: Large weapons, aggressive poses, red/orange tones
  Low: Defensive, soft designs
- Defense
  High: Armor, heavy equipment, sense of weight, shield-like expression
  Low: Light equipment, slender
- Speed
  High: Slender, dynamic poses, speed effects
  Low: Large, solid stance
- Intelligence
  High: Calm expression, sharp eyes, blue/purple tones, mechanical/magical symbols
  Low: Emotional, impression of brute force
- Magic Power
  High: Luminescence, aura, magic effects, surreal expressions
  Low: Realistic, few effects

[Important Rules]
Do not maximize all statuses. Balance them with strengths and weaknesses.

[Rarity Standards]
N: Standard
R: Strong aura and direction
SR: Overwhelming presence and amount of information
UR: Overwhelming presence and information, with gloss and shine over the whole card

[Skill Generation]
Auto-generate the following:
- Skill (Name + Effect)
- Special Move (Flashy name + powerful effect)

[Direction]
Apply effects based on attribute and magic power (fire, lightning, darkness, etc.)

[Output]
Ensure a professional card design that is organized and easy to read without overlapping text.

templates.title: Hand-drawn storyboard preview sketches
templates.prompt: Create a rough, hand-drawn PREVIS + rescue chase storyboard page in a 16:9 landscape format. Use an extremely simple 2D pre-draft sketch style: - Stick figure/human silhouette only - No facial details, no clothing details, no anatomical details - No textures, no shadows, no detailed rendering - Loose black sketch lines - Red boxes are only for camera framing - Blue arrows are only for indicating movement/strength/breathing/direction - Rough director's thumbnails, not concept art - Keep it as simple as possible if you're unsure; don't add details. Display 8 numbered panels on one page, arranged slightly irregularly but clearly and legibly. Main body:{argument name="subject" default="Two best friends race on skateboards in the sky above the clouds."} environment:{argument name="environment" default="A bright, open sky, fluffy cloud paths, drifting clouds, distant sunlight, followed by a dark storm cloud region with wind, rain, and lightning."} Atmosphere: Playful, adventurous, fast-paced, fun, with moments of suspense, then exhilarating and triumphant. Sequence: In a fun cloud skateboarding race, one friend accidentally drifts into a dangerous storm cloud and loses control, followed by a last-minute rescue by another. Rhythm Points: 1. Wide-angle setup shot. Two friends skateboard side-by-side above the clouds, playfully racing in the sky. 2. Side tracking shot. The race accelerates. One friend leans forward and takes a slight lead, the other close behind. 3. 3/4 front side view. The leading friend, focused on the race, accidentally veers into a dark storm cloud area ahead. 4. Overhead shot. The storm cloud engulfs the leading friend. Strong wind arrows, rain, and lightning. The skateboard shakes violently. 5. Close-up/medium shot action shot. The second friend senses the danger, slams on the brakes, then veers and rushes into the storm. 6. Dynamic low-angle shot. A rescuer on a skateboard rushes into the storm cloud, reaching out through wind, rain, and lightning to grab a trapped friend. 7. Hero Side Shot. A last-minute rescue. The rescuer grabs another friend's arm or hoodie, pulling them out of the storm cloud just as lightning strikes behind them. 8. Wide-Angle Ending Shot. The two friends rush back into the sunny clouds, regain their balance, and continue skating side-by-side, laughing as they continue their race. Use a variety of camera angles: close-up, wide-angle, low angle, overhead, side profile, rear, 3/4 perspective. Add brief handwritten notes near the panels. Maintain clear coherence between subjects, props, environment, and direction of movement. Focus on staging, camera, movement, timing, and coherence. Prioritize readability over drawing quality. Avoid elaborate illustrations, sleek UIs, and infographic designs. Target Tone: Fun, family-friendly animation energy, clear visual storytelling, and a simple, easy-to-read action rhythm.

templates.title: Chaotic MS Paint Sticker Emoji Set
templates.prompt:
Task Objective:
Generate a set of 16 chat-style sticker emojis based on the reference images. The result should feel expressive, highly shareable, and stylistically unified — but intentionally chaotic, low-quality, and humorous.

The final output should look like:
Someone who cannot draw, using a mouse in MS Paint, randomly doodling and writing text at the same time — messy, awkward, low-effort, but unexpectedly funny.

————————
Input Structure:

Image 1: Character reference (may include one or multiple subjects such as people, pets, or combinations)
Image 2: Layout reference (only for understanding the 4x4 grid structure, not style)

User Inputs:
- Text content (multiple lines, any language, may be fewer or more than 16)

————————
Character Usage Rules:

- Identify all possible subjects in Image 1 (people, animals, etc.)
- Each subject can act as a main character
- Different stickers can feature different characters
- Some stickers may include multiple characters interacting
- Distribution should feel natural and context-driven

————————
Consistency Definition (Critical Redefinition):

This task prioritizes “consistent imperfection”, NOT realistic consistency.

The same character across stickers:
Does NOT need to look identical,
but must feel like it was drawn by the same unskilled person.

Must be consistent in:
- Drawing behavior (same clumsy hand)
- Simplification logic
- Error patterns (crooked proportions, shaky lines)
- Overall messiness level

Allowed:
- Facial distortion
- Proportion inconsistency
- Structural errors
- Missing details

Must retain:
- Minimal recognizable traits (e.g. silhouette, color, signature features)

Summary:
Consistency = “wrong in the same way”, not “accurate likeness”

————————
Layout & Structure:

- 16 stickers total, arranged in a 4x4 grid
- Each sticker is an independent frame
- Can feature single or multiple characters
- Individual frames can be messy
- Overall grid must remain clear and readable

————————
Text System (Core Expression Layer):

User provides multiple lines of text:

Quantity Handling:
- If fewer than 16 → automatically complete to 16
- If more than 16 → select the most expressive 16

Language Rule:
- Use the same language as the user input
- Do NOT enforce any specific language

Completion Rules:
- Maintain tone consistency (sarcastic, lazy, emotional, clingy, absurd, etc.)
- Prefer internet-style expressions
- Short phrases preferred, but longer lines allowed
- Avoid repetition

Expression Goals:
- Instantly understandable
- Emotionally strong
- Feels like real meme text

Tone Priority:
- Complaints
- Self-talk
- Emotional bursts
- Indifference / annoyance / absurd humor

Avoid:
- Polite responses
- Formal or structured phrasing

————————
Text-Image Integration (Critical):

Text must be DRAWN, not typeset.

Must:
- Look like mouse handwriting (crooked, shaky, uneven size)
- Be messy (tilted, overlapping, misaligned)
- Have inconsistent spacing
- Be placed freely (on face, beside, edges, etc.)

Allowed:
- Repeated letters (aaaaa)
- Stretched words (soooo tired)
- Random punctuation (????!!!)
- Messy or ugly writing

Must:
- Remain readable
- Not block understanding

————————
Expression Generation Mechanism (Most Important):

Simulate this process:

“A person who cannot draw, using a mouse, doodling randomly while writing text at the same time.”

Key Rules:
- Image and text must come from the SAME moment
- Not: draw first, then add text
- But: draw and write simultaneously

Each sticker should feel like:
- Random doodle
- Then spontaneous writing
- Or both happening together

Should feel:
- Unplanned
- Careless
- Immediate

————————
Text-Image Relationship:

Text and visuals should form:
- Commentary
- Emotional amplification
- Self-talk
- Or slightly mismatched humor

Allowed:
- Loose or imperfect alignment
- Absurd or off-topic humor

Goal:
Not accuracy, but humor

————————
Aesthetic DNA (Core Style Driver):

Style origin:
Terrible MS Paint doodles + failed imitation + extremely low drawing skill

Visual Traits:

Lines:
- Shaky, unstable, jagged
- Mouse-drawn look

Forms:
- Bad proportions
- Stick figures or crude shapes
- Distorted structures

Details:
- Minimal or none
- “Cannot draw” feeling

Texture:
- Pixelated
- Rough edges

Composition:
- Frames can be messy
- Grid must stay readable

Emotion:
- Awkward, direct, absurd, funny

Resemblance:
- Only vaguely resembles the original
- Like a failed copy

————————
Style Enforcement (Critical):

When conflict occurs:

Realism vs Style → ALWAYS choose Style

Allowed to break:
- Detail
- Proportion
- Accuracy
- Cleanliness

Strictly forbid:
- Clean lines
- Correct anatomy
- Polished visuals
- Designed aesthetics

Rule:
If it looks “good”, it is WRONG.

Force it back to messy, ugly, low-effort.

————————
Anti-Template & Randomization System (Critical):

Strictly forbid:
- Numbering (1, 2, 3…)
- List-style output
- Sequential planning

Must treat all 16 stickers as:
“16 independent, random expressions”

Randomness Requirements:

- Vary text length
- Vary tone and emotion
- Some complete, some fragmented
- Some minimal or almost empty

Avoid:
- Repetition
- Predictable phrasing
- Common default responses

Allow:
- Abrupt or weird expressions
- Uneven density
- Inconsistent structure

Generation Method:

Do NOT plan all 16.

Instead simulate:
“16 separate spontaneous moments”

Must include:
- Emotional fluctuation
- Instability
- Randomness

Anti-reuse rule:

Each generation must:
- Avoid repeating previous outputs
- Avoid fixed patterns
- Feel freshly created

————————
Sticker Requirements:

- Each sticker visually distinct
- Clear emotional signal
- Usable in chat
- Strong expressive power

————————
Final Goal:

Generate 16 stickers.

The result must feel like:

“A person who cannot draw used a mouse to doodle 16 times,
randomly writing emotional thoughts each time —
messy, inconsistent, but unexpectedly funny.”

NOT:

“A clean, well-designed AI sticker set”

templates.title: The minimalist literary cover of *Educated*
templates.prompt: Design an exquisite, minimalist collage-style cover for a Chinese literary book. The background is a warm white textured paper with a subtle grainy and slightly aged feel. The composition is tall and elegant, with a striking vertical Chinese title in the center on the right, written in an aged black calligraphic font. The title reads "You should fly like a bird to your mountain," arranged in two columns: "You should fly like a bird" on the right and "Fly to your mountain" on the left. Near the top center is a delicate indigo bird, its flight path extending diagonally downwards, passing through the title and pointing to the lower right, creating a sense of ascension and freedom. In the lower left is a large triangular mountain shape, resembling a torn paper collage or wedge painting, with white snow-capped peaks that gradually transition to deep ultramarine and navy blue textures. A faint vertical line of English text is integrated into the right edge of the mountain, as if the mountain were pieced together from printed pages. Inside the blue mountain, the original English title is typed in white serif font: "Educated" on the first line, followed by "A Memoir." Add a small section of vertically arranged black Chinese quotations in the upper left corner, arranged in six lines, followed by a long dash, then two lines of the author's name "Tara Westover" in soft blue serif font, and then another dash. Add thin, vertically arranged copyright information in the lower right corner, including the author's Chinese name, followed by the blue English name "Tara Westover," and below that, black translator and publisher information. Maintain a spacious layout, utilizing strong white space and asymmetrical balance to present a poetic contemporary publishing aesthetic. Use only three primary colors: black, off-white, and indigo. The overall atmosphere should convey an intellectual, restrained, modern, and award-winning quality, suitable for works by [author's name - likely a writer or author].{argument name="author name" default="Tara Westover"} Creation{argument name="book title" default="Educated"} High-end version.

Her hairstyle is a classic low bun, with long hair cascading down her back, embellished with delicate gold ornaments and pearl floral hairpins. The face should remain clear in the final image, conveying a tranquil and elegant expression. The scene is constructed atop a dramatic, dark gray ink-wash rock, which surrounds her from behind and below like a chair, its edges featuring a soft, smoky watercolor effect. A slender, winding metallic gold line extends from the upper right corner to the lower left center. A blooming plum blossom branch extends diagonally from the right, adorned with small white flowers and dark branches. Chinese characters are incorporated into the poster design: three large vertical characters in the upper left corner, containing the following text:{argument name="character name" default="Lin Daiyu"} Below is the Romanized "LIN DAIYU" in small-spaced serif font; next to the pinyin is a column of slender vertical Chinese poems; another column of short vertical Chinese text is added in the lower right middle section; and a short horizontal Chinese sentence is added at the bottom center. templates.title: Minimalist Educational Infographic Template
templates.prompt: A simple educational infographic poster is used to explain "{argument name="topic" default="theme"} [Overall Style] Modern minimalist UI style, with soft light background colors (e.g., cream #FAF7F2 / light gray-blue), a restrained and comfortable color scheme suitable for long-term reading. [Core Requirements (Key)] Organize content modules naturally according to the information structure of the "theme". Do not force a fixed number or order of modules; prioritize clear logical information over formal symmetry. [Layout (Adaptive)] - Use a grid layout (automatically select 2 columns / 3 columns / irregular distribution) - Adjust the number of cards according to the content (usually 5–9) - High information density modules can be enlarged (increase visual weight) - Simple modules can be shrunk or merged [Card Design] - White cards (#FFFFFF) - Rounded corners + subtle shadows (soft sense of hierarchy) - Maintain consistent spacing and alignment [Each information module contains] - Simple illustrations (consistent style) - Clear headings (strong sense of hierarchy) - 1–3 core explanatory sentences (avoid verbosity) - Provide examples/comparisons/where necessary Summary [Content Organization Principles (Key)] Automatically select an appropriate structure based on the theme, for example: - Conceptual → Definition + Principle + Features + Examples - Comparison → A vs B (Comparison Structure) - Process → Steps/Flowchart - System → Components + Relationships - Skill → Methods + Techniques + Common Mistakes [Visual Hierarchy] - Title > Module Title > Body > Auxiliary Information - Important information can be highlighted with color or icons [Color Suggestions] - Primary Color: Choose according to the theme (Technology = Blue, Learning = Green, Warning = Orange) - Secondary Colors: 1–2 colors are sufficient - Avoid high saturation and flashy color schemes [Style Requirements] - Sufficient white space, with a strong sense of "breathing" - Unified icons (linear or flat) - Prioritize high readability - Clear educational orientation [Additional Optimization (Optional)] - May include: comparison modules/flow arrows/structure diagrams - A "core summary" module can be set as a visual ending.

templates.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo to generate a 9:16 vertical calendar card.

[1. Execution Mode — Critical]

This is an image editing task, NOT image generation.

Use the original photo as the base layer
Do NOT recreate, redraw, or reinterpret the image

Strictly preserve:

face, identity, expression, hair, body, clothing
original lighting, shadows, color temperature
environment and composition

❗ No beautification, no smoothing, no retouching
❗ The photo must look unchanged

[2. Allowed Operations — Overlay Only]

Only add design elements on top:

bottom 30% soft gradient extension (for calendar area)
subtle translucent mask for readability
calendar layout, month title, and short caption

Forbidden:

repainting or altering existing pixels
changing global color style
applying “design filters”
[3. Color Strategy]

Colors must come from the current image:

extract primary / secondary / accent colors
apply slight desaturation and brightness normalization only
keep original photo color feeling

👉 Respect the image, do not redesign the color system

[4. Layout Structure]
Top 70%: original image (untouched)
Bottom 30%: gradient + calendar
smooth transition, no hard edges
clean spacing, minimal design
magazine-like, not template-style
[5. Calendar Content — Must Be Accurate]

Generate correct calendar for the given month:

Title: {argument name="month title" default="July 2026 / 2026.07"}
Weekdays: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
Dates: accurate alignment based on real calendar
[6. Caption Rules — Important]

Length: 8–16 words (or equivalent short phrase)

Requirements:

max 2 lines
no exclamation marks
no clichés, no motivational tone
do NOT explain emotions

Preferred style:

subtle, atmospheric
fragment-like, not fully explanatory
leave emotional space

👉 Make people pause, not finish reading

[7. Image Selection Guidance — Key to Success]

Prefer:

side face / partially hidden face
natural遮挡 (hat, hand, shadow)
motion (walking, turning)
mood > facial detail

Avoid:
front-facing portraits
strong identity-focused close-ups

👉 Reduce face-modification risk

[Final Principle]

👉 Do NOT generate a better photo.
Gently place design on the original photo.

Behind him, a massive, purplish-green Evangelion Unit-01 mecha lunges forward from the upper right corner, its head and shoulders enormous, a claw-like hand reaching in from the left, and details of its eyes and mouth glowing magenta. The bottom third shows broken black rubble, reflective wetlands, sparks, dust, and upward-slicing purple lightning bolts. Use strong depth of field: the subject and mecha are sharp, while the smoky background debris gradually fades into the haze. Mecha and action details: A massive EVA Unit-01, with angular armor plates, a black and dark purple body accented with fluorescent green, long horns, glowing red eyes, an open mechanical jaw, and an aggressive crouching stance. Text content: The poster must include 11 unique print design elements: 1) A large main title at the top.{argument name="main title" default="EVANGELION"} ; 2) The small label on the left: "NEON GENESIS EVANGELION"; 3) The large issue number on the left.{argument name="issue number" default="01"} 4) A small black shaded rectangle below the issue number; 5) The "TEST TYPE" label on the left; 6) The Japanese aircraft label.{argument name="Japanese unit label" default="Unit-01"} 7) Short quote: "God's in his heaven. The overall aesthetic is bright, friendly, and cute fantasy game aesthetics. Main layout: Place the full-body character photo in a scrapbook style on the right-center position, with a white sticker border and pink shading. She is crouching, smiling at the camera, making a peace sign next to her face, wearing a white short-sleeved shirt embroidered with small red flowers, a white pleated skirt, white socks, and pink shoes, with light blonde short bob haircut and a pink flower hair accessory. Her pet dog is lying at her feet slightly below the center, a brown and white small hound wearing a pink harness or outfit. If necessary, the facial area can be simplified or softened, but the pose and cute atmosphere must be preserved. Title Area: Place a large hand-drawn Japanese title "POCHIINA" in the upper left corner, next to a paw print mark, and below it a pink ribbon that says "POCHIINA". Add small flowers, stars, hearts, and a detailed sketch-style rectangular title box. Data Panels and Text: Use 12 separate data panels around the main character. 1) The upper left corner is the species/origin description panel with Japanese labels, describing her as a human who uses healing magic and was born into a family that loves flowers and animals. 2) The left side is the STATUS panel, containing 7 rows of attribute data and a pink horizontal progress bar: HP 840, MP 620, Attack 420, Defense 380, Magic 760, Agility 720, Luck 890, each with a small icon. 3) The bottom panel displays a magic flower staff labeled "お花のステッキ" (Ohana no Steki), accompanied by an illustration of the staff. 4) The special attack panel is labeled "必殺技" (Bishouji), described as "Happy Flower Shine," a healing flower-based attack. 5) The bottom left corner is the partner panel, labeled "相棒：わんこ" (Aibou: Wanko), describing this pet dog. 6) A circular illustration near the bottom center shows the girl and her dog standing in a pink magical flower field. 7) A speech bubble near the character's head reads "今日も一緒にたのしくいこっ！" (Kyou mo Ichiso ni Ta no Shikui Kok!). 8) The top right corner displays a rarity card labeled "RARITY," containing 5 stars: four solid pink stars and one hollow gray star. 9) The personality panel is labeled "性" (Xìngnì), using four short sentences to describe kindness, cheerfulness, compassion, and a healing aura. 10) The likes/dislikes panel is divided into two columns: likes are marked with heart icons, and dislikes are marked with blue cloud/raindrop icons. 11) The special skills panel is labeled "得意なこと" (Delightful Things), listing four items, such as healing the wounded, cheering on others, cultivating flowers, and taking photos with a peace sign. 12) The right side is the weakness and background story area, divided into small note boxes labeled "弱分" (Weakness) and "その他・フレーバーテキスト" (Other Friend Skills), describing feelings of loneliness, being too kind, being nervous in public, always being with a dog, searching for small flowers, and gently changing the world with a smile. Visual style: soft natural light, pink highlights, sketch-style brown outlines, delicate handwritten Japanese font, scrapbook collage, sticker borders, and a comfortable magical girl RPG data card design. Keep the screen information rich and easy to read; all panels should be evenly distributed around the central character silhouette. The top displays a title bar, a hamburger menu icon on the left, a rounded label with "ChatGPT" in the middle, and two icons on the right: a compose icon and a three-dot menu. Below are three rounded cat thumbnails: the first shows an orange and white cat sleeping on a plush cushion under a black metal chair frame on a wooden floor; the second shows a calico cat curled up on a light green round cushion in bed; and the third shows a cream-colored cat curled up sleeping in a brown plush pet bed. Below the thumbnails is a dark gray chat bubble containing the Japanese text: “これを良い感じにfacebookのストーリーに流せる感じにして。ばえるかんじで。” Below the message, the generated image is displayed: a tall, vertical Facebook Story-style collage that blends the three cat photos into a warm, comforting composition. The top area features an orange and white cat under a chair, the middle area a curled-up calico cat, and the bottom area a cream-colored cat in a fluffy bed. Soft beige and brown tones, dreamy lighting, subtle bokeh, delicate glitter, and a gentle lifestyle aesthetic are applied. Cute Japanese handwritten-style overlay text and stickers are added to the collage: a speech bubble near the top reads "Today is here♡", a vertical sticky note on the left reads "Minna sorezore otori no bazo de", two small heart doodles near the center, and a large diagonal title "Shiawasesuyasuya time." In the bottom left corner of the generated image, a rounded, dark button labeled "编集する" (Edit), and a circular download icon with a downward arrow is placed near the bottom center. At the very bottom of the screen, there is a ChatGPT input bar with a plus icon, placeholder text "ChatGPT に质问…" (ChatGPT に质问…), a microphone icon, and a circular voice button. This makes the overall image look like a realistic application screenshot, vertically oriented, with a thin white scroll bar visible on the right edge.

She has short, straight hair, pale skin, and wears oversized round goggles with glowing red lenses. She wears a dark, oversized hoodie and holds a can of black energy drink close to the viewer. Her hoodie features cat-themed details and accessories, surrounded by hand-drawn white graffiti lines: exactly six cat faces or cat characters, four bats, four stars, two hearts, and several lightning bolt graffiti and sparkle marks. The can is black with red accents and a cat logo, and features the bold English text "NEKON ENERGY" and "BLACK SHOCK." In the midground and background, an abandoned futuristic city canyon extends towards a bright red energy burst at the center. At the top center, a large, distressed white Japanese title dominates the poster:{argument name="headline text" default="Instinct awakens."} The smaller white Japanese subtitle below reads:{argument name="tagline text" default="Cut through the darkness and surpass your limits."} In the top left corner, create a vertical list containing three benefits, each with a small white icon and Japanese text. The first section has a lightning bolt icon, titled "The Strongest Benefit," with the subtitle "Caffeine 160mg Alginin Combined." templates.title: Nighttime train racing HUD scene
templates.prompt: This is a cinematic nighttime action scene, inspired by the HUD design of arcade racing games, showcasing two Japanese commuter trains racing side-by-side on a dense network of elevated tracks in a nighttime city. The camera is positioned low and slightly ahead of the trains, at a three-quarter angle to the left front, with strong motion blur sweeping across the tracks, buildings, and overhead power lines to emphasize the sense of speed. The train on the left is a modern, bright red commuter train with a cream-colored front end, its route display showing "Shinagawa," and its locomotive number 2100. The train on the right is a classic, dark maroon commuter train with warm interior lighting, dual headlights, its locomotive number 2000, and a circular front emblem bearing the word "Racing," with smaller text below reading "Kurihama → Shinagawa." The maroon train is slightly ahead. The background is a dark urban skyline, dotted with office building lights and railway overhead contact lines, with Tokyo Tower visible in the distance on the right horizon. The deep, high-contrast color palette, composed of black, charcoal gray, deep red, amber window lights, and metallic reflections, creates a glossy, realistic photographic style. A clean white racing game interface is overlaid on the image. It includes 5 UI components: 1) A small circular map in the upper left corner with location markers, a simple route line, and the text "5.4 km"; below are two lines of Japanese text: "京急本下り" (Kyokyu Honsui Line) and "京急久里浜→品川" (Kyokyu Kyurihama → Shinagawa). 2) A speed display in the upper right corner showing a large number "168" and a smaller "km/h" below, separated by a thin horizontal line, with "4 segments" displayed below. 3) A vertical control gauge in the lower left corner, labeled "BC" at the top, with increments from 12 to 1, and the letters B, N, and P on the left; a small green indicator light is near the number 7. 4) A horizontal bar gauge in the center at the bottom, labeled "ブレーキ" (Brake) on the left and "パワー" (Power) on the right, filled with a blue-purple-red gradient, with a scale from 0 to 200 km/h below. 5) A circular pressure gauge in the lower right corner, labeled "kPa," with scales of 0, 200, 400, 800, and 1000. Below it are "MR" and "BC," accompanied by corresponding vertical numerical markings. The HUD should maintain a minimalist, slender, elegant, and semi-transparent design, resembling a futuristic train racing dashboard. The image should be ultra-detailed, dynamic, and realistic, with a dramatic long-exposure energy feel. There should be no figures in the foreground, and no additional panels or split-screen layouts.

templates.title: Luxury Black Truffle Wagyu Burger Poster
templates.prompt: Objective: To create a high-end vertical restaurant promotional poster for a luxury gourmet burger brand.{argument name="brand name" default="Burger N"} The advertisement features a beige, luxurious food advertising background and a realistic, alluring photographic style. Canvas: Vertical poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, warm-toned creamy paper background, centered composition, high-end casual dining aesthetics, color scheme of black, dark brown, caramel orange, and cream. Top Brand Logo: A minimalist black "N" logo with a small orange dot is placed at the top center, below which is the brand text "Burger N," followed by the Chinese slogan "一口堕落" (One Bite of Debauchery), flanked by thin orange dividing lines. Below this, a small crown icon is added above the main title. Main Title: The upper center uses a striking, bold, distressed-style Chinese font.{argument name="headline text" default="Black truffle foie gras and beef burger"} The lower part is accented with curved orange lines, flanked by small orange decorative stars. Below the title is the subtitle "Luxurious Debauchery, One Bite is Intoxicating," accompanied by two small orange stars. The main course: A massive, hyper-realistic black truffle, foie gras, and Wagyu beef burger sits at the center. It features a matte charcoal-black bun sprinkled with black sesame seeds, thick, glossy pan-seared foie gras slices, rich black truffle sauce cascading down, melted yellow cheese stretching downwards, and a juicy, coarsely ground Wagyu beef patty with pink veins, all complemented by fresh leafy greens and a dark bottom bun. The bottom of the burger is surrounded by truffle bits, peppercorns, sauce splatters, and slices of black truffle. The lighting uses soft, studio-style food lighting with highlights, shallow depth of field, and an overall appealing and upscale feel. Left-side ingredient section: Four ingredient highlight labels are added to the left, below the dark, rounded label "INGREDIENTS". Each label includes a small, realistic image of the ingredient, a dotted, curved guide line pointing towards the burger, and Chinese text. The four labels are: 1) Marbled raw Wagyu beef steak, labeled "Australian Wagyu/Coarsely ground meat patty"; 2) Pan-seared foie gras slices, labeled "French foie gras/Crispy on both sides"; 3) Black truffle sauce bowl, labeled "Black truffle sauce/Truffle content ≥12%"; 4) Glossy brioche bread, labeled "Brioche bread/Butter ratio 18%". Right-side selling point panel: Add a rounded-corner vertical cream-colored card on the right, titled "PRODUCT BENEFITS". It contains four stacked selling points, accompanied by round dark icons and Chinese text: 1) Crown icon, "Double luxury ingredients/Wagyu + Foie gras"; 2) Spatula or knife icon, "Freshly grilled to order/Juicy and not flattened"; 3) Cheese icon, "Triple cheese/Cheddar + Mozzarella + Parmesan"; 4) Takeout box icon, "Carry-on single box/Not collapsed or wet". Price & CTA: Place a dark brown, bold-stroke price banner near the bottom center. The banner features a small orange "PRICE" and a large white price.{argument name="price" default="89"} Followed by "Yuan/Set". Below this, add a rounded call-to-action button containing bold Chinese text.{argument name="call to action" default="Falling into depravity now"} And a right-pointing arrow. Footer: Add a thin horizontal line, followed by small Chinese footer text: "For more delicious food, search on your favorite platforms." Add a dark search capsule containing the text "Burger N" and a magnifying glass icon, followed by five platform logos/icons: Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Meituan, Dianping, and a small orange restaurant app-style icon. Keep all footer elements simple and aligned to the bottom. Visual Style: High-end Chinese food advertising poster, combining realistic product photography with simple graphic design, a strong central food subject, clear typography, delicate paper texture, sophisticated shadows, no human figures in the image, and no extra clutter except for listed ingredients, icons, and text.

At the center of the composition is a large serif Latin wordmark.{argument name="typeface name" default="KASEI"} Below the title are two oversized Japanese kanji characters, “華世”, in a matching high-contrast classical style. To the right of the title area is a vertical Japanese slogan: “经典の美、未来の书体.” (Classical beauty, future calligraphy). Below the main kanji is the subtitle “A ROMAN × JAPANESE TYPEFACE,” and below that is a line of vermilion Japanese text: “ロмаの精神、日本の美.” "(The spirit of Rome, the beauty of Japan)". On the far left, create a narrow sidebar containing stacked English text "A TYPEFACE HARMONIZING ROME AND JAPAN", a small circular badge, Japanese text "制作—MMXXIV" and "CREATED IN KYOTO, JAPAN". The lower two-thirds are structured as a rigorous font sample table with clearly labeled areas. The left sidebar contains two sections: "WEIGHTS" with five items—Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold; and "POINT SIZES" with nine items—8pt, 10pt, 12pt, 14pt, 18pt, 24pt, 36pt, 48pt, 72pt. The main area contains a section titled "ROMAN CHARACTERS" displaying four lines of samples: uppercase letters A to Z, lowercase letters a to z, and the number 0. Up to number 9, and a line of punctuation/symbols, including forward slashes, commas, semicolons, exclamation marks, question marks, apostrophes, quotation marks, long dashes, parentheses, square brackets, curly braces, ampersands, at symbols, dollar signs, asterisks, swords, and double swords. Below that is a section titled "JAPANESE CHARACTERS," containing 4 lines: 19 kanji “日月山川花鸟风林火水土金木道心时空光梦永”, 23 hiragana “あいうえおかきくけこさしすせそたちつてとなにぬねの”, 21 The first line contains the katakana characters “アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソンタチツテトナニヌネノ”, and a line of symbols including Japanese punctuation, angle brackets, tildes, separators, parentheses, angle brackets, double angle brackets, black-cornered brackets, postal symbols, reference symbols, and reduplicated characters. On the next line, add four compact sample panels: “LIGATURES” with 10 items—Æ, AE, AJ, Œ, KA, KE, KI, KO, KU and “st ct fi fl ft fb”; and “STYLISTIC ALTERNATES” with 12 items—A, A, A, R, R, K, K, a, a, g, g, y, y, J, J, Q, Q, t, t. — The samples are arranged in a neat grid; “SPACING STUDY” displays the word “KASEI” with wide letter spacing, above the kanji “华世永美”; and “NUMERAL STYLES” contains four lines—uniform numerals 0123456789, old-style numerals 0123456789, and small capital letter combinations “H 0123” and “H 0123”. Tiny red Japanese descriptions are added below some sample boxes. At the bottom, three function panels are created. The center panel contains a large Japanese quote: “時を越え、美は残る”. "(Beyond Time, Beauty Endures)," the English statement above reads "BEAUTY ENDURES BEYOND TIME," along with a small red signature "— KASEI." The right panel, titled "DETAILS," displays a large Chinese character "永" (yong, meaning eternal), against a background of subtle circular patterns and auxiliary lines, plus four right-aligned Japanese annotations connected by thin dotted lines. Finally, the footer contains four sections: a small badge with "KASEI TYPE FOUNDRY" and "WWW.KASEIFOUNDRY.JP"; a centered language support description "SUPPORTING 200+ LANGUAGES" and "LATIN / GREEK / CYRILLIC / JAPANESE / SYMBOLS"; the right-hand statement "DESIGNED WITH RESPECT CRAFTED FOR THE FUTURE"; and a label bearing the name "华世" (Huashi). A square vermilion seal. templates.title: Soft anime-style blueberry cake movie poster
templates.prompt: A dreamy, softly animated movie poster illustration is set in a narrow outdoor alleyway covered with a dense mosaic of floral patterns. The image evokes shimmering starlight, soft mist, and a romantic shoujo manga color palette of lavender, pink, periwinkle, and cream. The foreground shows a lovely girl, her back partially obscured in profile, her face mostly hidden. She has a short, silver-lavender bob and wears a large, pale purple bow adorned with small flowers. She wears an oversized, semi-transparent pale purple hoodie with floral appliqués on the sleeves, paired with a layered, soft-toned skirt, and carries a shimmering pale purple backpack adorned with charms, ribbons, pom-poms, badges, and star decorations. She holds a slice of blueberry pound cake, its center dramatically overflowing with glossy, deep purple blueberry filling, thick syrup flowing across the cake and plate. Whole blueberries are scattered around the cake and below in the foreground. Despite the beautiful visuals, the overall atmosphere should be fantastical, sophisticated, and with a touch of comedy. The image is designed like a Japanese movie poster, featuring numerous decorative text overlays and laurel leaf embellishments. At the top, there are three lines of small award descriptions with laurel wreaths. Add a large handwritten Japanese title in a layered pink, white, and purple font with glowing, sticker-like outlines: “冷凍したブルーベリー使ってパウンドケーキ焼いたら中身溢れて失敗した件.” (Translation: The story of how a pound cake made with frozen blueberries failed because the filling overflowed.) Below, add a smaller subtitle: “〜甘くて、ちょっぴり切ない青春のレシピ〜” (Translation: ~A sweet yet slightly bittersweet recipe for youth~). Place a vertical white quote box on the right containing the Japanese phrase: "うまくいかない日だって、人生のスパイスになるんだ。" (Even the worst days are part of life.) In the bottom left corner, add a pink sticky note that reads "Sweet but clumsy," along with a torn-out page from a handwritten Japanese list. Near the cake, add a small speech bubble that reads "Oops!" Near the bottom right corner, add a circular stamp-like seal that reads "Blueberry disaster." At the bottom, add white movie credits-style text, including "A FILM BY YUMEIRO PASTEL," and a large pink and white release date:{argument name="release date" default="2024.6.30(SUN)"} "ROADSHOW". Add the Japanese tagline below: "失敗は、最高の思い出になる。だから、また挑戦しよう。" (Translation: Failure can become the best memory. So, let's challenge ourselves again.) Frame the entire poster with lace, stickers, confetti, and scrapbook-style decorations. The image should be highly detailed, glossy, sensual, cute, and cinematic, deliberately creating an exaggerated effect reminiscent of a coming-of-age movie poster about baking failure.

The second girl is in the lower left, with long, light silver hair, wearing a ribbon accessory, and slightly turned away. The third girl is in the lower center of the image, smaller in stature, with purplish-red or reddish-brown hair, her posture lowered, slightly sorrowful. The fourth girl is in the middle right, with golden or light brown hair, looking up at the sky with a hopeful expression. At the very bottom center of the main visual, two tiny full-body silhouettes are displayed: a boy and a girl holding hands in a glowing distance, their reflections shimmering on the damp ground. A white feather is added to the upper left, and cherry blossom petals are scattered throughout the image. An elegant Japanese title typography, using a large white, brush-style serif font, is overlaid from the lower left to the center:{argument name="title text" default="On the other side of goodbye"} Below this is a smaller subtitle. On the far left edge, three lines of small white Japanese promotional text are arranged vertically. In the lower left corner, two stacked black product labels with white text, similar to PC game packaging badges, are added; one says "Windows Compatible," and the other "Suitable for All Ages." A narrow, deep indigo vertical band separates the artwork from the information panel. On this band, the large white Japanese game title is again placed vertically, with a smaller vertical tagline below. This area is kept clean and elegant, like the spine of a game box. The right third is a soft cream-colored information panel with a delicate paper-like texture. In the upper left of this panel, a bold Japanese title in brackets is added: "【あらすじ】", followed by a few lines of Japanese plot synopsis, formatted like a visual novel description page. A dotted dividing line is added below. Then, a second bracketed title is added: "【特徴】", containing four key features, each preceded by a simple icon. The four features are: branch selection, full voice support, heart-wrenching emotional stories, and a large number of exquisite CGs. Use dark blue-gray icons and text. Add another dividing line, followed by a third bracket title: "【To Playboy】", followed by two short lines of Japanese messages. Thumbnail 1: The dark-haired heroine by a railing at the beach at sunset. Thumbnail 2: The light-haired heroine against a backdrop of azure sea, her hair flowing in the wind. templates.title: Japanese realistic romance movie poster
templates.prompt: This Japanese-style realistic romance movie poster, inspired by the film *A Bouquet of Love*, depicts a young Japanese couple in their twenties standing in an everyday urban scene (street or intersection), maintaining a subtle yet realistic distance. There is no physical contact, as if capturing the moment of estrangement in their relationship. The atmosphere is quiet and restrained, conveying unspoken emotions and a sense of the passage of time. The composition follows the film's main visual style, with the figures positioned at the bottom or to one side, leaving ample white space to emphasize the space and atmosphere. The lighting is natural (overcast or at dusk), with low-saturation gray-blue, beige, and warm gray tones, possessing a realistic photographic quality. The image has a delicate film grain and a subtle sense of everyday life, not deliberately pursuing beauty or excessive decoration, like a frame from a real film. A small amount of natural flowers can be added to the edges or foreground as a metaphor (restrained, not excessive, not decorative). The title "I Made a Beautiful Bouquet" is added in the white space using Mingti font, with a simple and sparse layout; below, "We Made a Beautiful Bouquet" is added in a smaller font. Overall Requirements: Authentic Japanese movie poster quality, artistic, restrained, and with a sense of everyday life. Emphasize character relationships rather than romantic symbols, avoiding saccharine romance, excessive floral displays, trendy aesthetics, crowded compositions, and an "exquisite but empty" AI feel. Negative keywords: AI feel, overly beautified, floral displays, romantic filters, excessive lighting effects, high saturation, neon lights, intimate embraces, posed shots, close-up portrait compositions, trendy style, illustration-like feel, 3D rendering, cluttered elements. A minimalist Japanese art movie poster style, inspired by the film *Love Letter*, featuring a winter snow scene, close-ups of a young woman's face, her face close to or partially buried in the snow, with fine snowflakes falling naturally. The composition should be a restrained profile close-up or a slightly tilted face, with the figure occupying a large proportion of the frame but not overly sharp, with slightly softened or slightly out-of-focus edges. The expression is one of calm after grief, with tears in the eyes or tear stains, emotions restrained and controlled, as if one has just cried and is slowly returning to silence. The eyes do not look directly at the camera, conveying a sense of memory and emptiness. The lighting is natural diffused winter light or soft, overcast light, with cool white, light gray, and pale blue tones, low saturation, low contrast, no strong shadows, and no dramatic lighting effects. Snow and air form a clean background. The image texture is between realistic photography and film, with fine grain, a slight haze, and slightly washed out or slightly overexposed, like an old photograph or movie still faded by time. The skin is not overly detailed, with no smoothing, sharpening, or retouching. The composition is asymmetrical, with the face partially cropped, a minimalist background, and appropriate white space. A minimalist title, "Love Letter" or "ラヴレター," is added to the white space using a light Ming or light serif font, with wide letter spacing, sparse typography, and a light gray color; "Love Letter" is added below in a very small font. Overall Requirements: A realistic Japanese art film poster aesthetic—quiet, subtle, and restrained, like a memory covered in snow. Avoid studio-style designs, trendy aesthetics, overly refined filters, special lighting effects, high contrast and saturation, a sharp, digital look, dramatic emotions, and being "beautiful but empty." Negative keywords: AI-like appearance, skin smoothing, sharpening, HDR, high contrast, high saturation, dreamlike lighting effects, lens flare, filter-like feel, studio style, trendy face, posed shots, staring directly at the camera, exaggerated emotions, 3D rendering, illustration style, complex backgrounds.

templates.title: Anime Samurai Game Advertisement Poster
templates.prompt: Create a highly impactful vertical mobile game advertisement poster, employing a glossy anime action style to present a dramatic cyberpunk samurai fantasy aesthetic, along with a compact and sophisticated gacha RPG promotional composition. The main image features two young male warriors, dressed in modern black business suits, crouching in an offensive stance in the foreground, each drawing their katana. Both have stylish blond hair, sharp facial features, and are handsome, wearing white shirts and blue ties. Their poses are full of tension, with their hands and swords dominating the lower foreground. A blue ribbon is tied near the hilt of one of the swords. Behind them, in the center, is a massive armored mech samurai with ornate golden horns, layered metallic blue-black armor, glowing blue eyes, and a sheathed sword across its back, resembling a guardian deity. The background features a vibrant neon city and energy burst effects, with electric blue, violet, magenta, and gold as the main colors, complemented by beams of light, sparks, petals, slashing effects, and ink-wash explosion textures. A vertical black brushstroke banner is added to the upper right corner, bearing the striking white Japanese characters "この刃で、未来を斬り拓け。" (This blade cuts through the future). In the lower center, a large gold Japanese calligraphy title, with a heavy brushstroke texture and black shadow, reads "切り捨て御免" (Cut off and be spared), spanning almost the entire width of the screen. In the bottom left corner, a screenshot panel with a gold border is embedded, showcasing a night battle scene in front of a red Japanese temple courtyard. A playable swordsman is fighting, surrounded by multiple enemies. Floating damage numbers include 5324, 5329, and 6132. A virtual joystick is located on the left, and five character portraits are arranged at the bottom and sides. There are three circular skill buttons on the right, and the top HUD displays a timer of approximately 01:28 and WAVE 3/3. In the bottom right corner, a large black and white QR code is placed within a white square. Below and to the side, the Japanese text "今すぐダウンロード" (Imasugu Down Road) is added in bold white font with a blue outline. At the very bottom, there are two official-style app store logos: App Store on the left and Google Play on the right. Overall appearance: ultra-refined and exquisite key visuals, dynamic perspective, metallic highlights, sharp cel animation rendering, high-end mobile game marketing posters, strong action energy, cinematic lighting and shadows, and a layered, richly layered UI promotional layout.

templates.title: Pink Idol Anime Lock Screen
templates.prompt: This is an incredibly detailed anime-style smartphone lock screen wallpaper, using a 9:16 portrait orientation and featuring a dazzling pink idol aesthetic theme. The main character in the image is {argument name="character name" default="Akari"} A lively magical idol girl with super long and fluffy hair{argument name="hair color" default="Soft pink"} She has twin ponytails, bright green eyes, fair skin, and a playful, lively expression. She wears a gorgeous, ruffled stage costume in layers of pink, pale purple, and white, adorned with gold trim, ribbons, heart patterns, lace cuffs, a choker bow, star earrings, and a flower-shaped hair accessory. The background is a dreamy pink mist, embellished with light spots, glitter, and soft glow effects. The design mimics a phone lock screen, featuring a large white lock icon at the top center, a cellular network status icon in the upper right corner, and the date displayed in Japanese as "May 22nd, Thursday." Above this is a large, glowing time display.{argument name="time display" default="22:22"} The image features five representations of the same character: a central half-body figure blinking and playfully touching its lips with a finger; a bust in the upper left corner laughing with its eyes closed; a full-body or three-quarter-body figure in the upper right corner joyfully raising a small magic wand or key-shaped object; a small figure in the lower left corner with its face obscured by a blurred pink rectangle, reaching out; and a crouching figure in the lower right corner, also with its face obscured by a blurred pink rectangle, interacting with a large physical lock. Handwritten Japanese onomatopoeia, including playful exclamations and annotations, are added around the characters. Two iPhone-style message notification banners, both from "メッセージ" and "お兄ちゃん," display the message "今どこ〜？" (What's up now?), one tilted to the left and the other vertically placed on the right. A rounded, semi-transparent slider with the Japanese phrase "スライドでロック解除" (Slide to unlock) and a lock icon is placed at the bottom of the screen. The unlocking concept is materialized by attaching an oversized brass padlock and latch to the slider, with a character in the lower right corner attempting to open it with a key; handwritten Japanese text nearby hints at the lock's removal and a metallic click sound. The lower left corner contains two circular utility icons: a flashlight and a trash can, as well as a manga-style speech bubble that reads "ポイッ!" (Pocky!). The lower right corner features a camera icon within a dark circular button, and at the very bottom is a thin, white home screen indicator. The overall rendering uses a refined, glossy anime illustration quality, with soft lighting, dense flashes, a sense of layered transparency, and a cute, playful atmosphere, as if an idol character has taken over the phone and physically prevented the screen from unlocking.

templates.prompt: A meticulously crafted poster for a Japanese animated feature film, presented vertically in a single sheet format, rendered with high-end cinematic detail and bright natural light. The composition features a dramatic group portrait of six teenagers against a backdrop of a bright blue sky, soft clouds, distant white birds, shimmering water, and lush vegetation in the foreground. The left side of the background depicts the ruins of a futuristic eco-city, partially covered by vegetation, seamlessly blending nature with advanced science. At the top center, two main characters stand back-to-back, serving as the visual focal point: on the left is a tall boy with messy short white hair, pale skin, a calm and serious expression, wearing a shirt, tie, and white lab coat, turned to the left; on the right is a tall girl with black hair neatly styled in a bun, pale skin, a composed expression, wearing a dark school uniform-style outfit with a white collar and ribbon, turned to the right. In the foreground below them stands a female student with a straight black bob, pale skin, wearing a black uniform with a large dark red bow, facing forward, her expression quiet and reserved. To the left center stands a dark-haired boy, wearing a dark suit and tie, turned to the left. To the right center stands a boy with messy brown hair, wearing a blue hoodie under a dark jacket, turned to the right. To the lower left stands a girl with long, soft light brown hair, wearing a light pink cardigan over a light-colored top, one hand on her chest, her expression gentle yet slightly anxious. The anatomy of each character is consistent and clearly defined, hair is rendered elegantly, clothing folds are delicate, and expressions are restrained yet emotional. Warm rim lighting and soft atmospheric glow, complemented by delicate lens flare and oil painting-like highlights, create an atmosphere full of hope and contemplation. Japanese typography design is incorporated into the poster: the vertical slogan in the upper left corner is "その选択が, the scenery of the future を変える.", and the vertical slogan in the upper right corner is "Natural と, Science と、心をつなぐ路へ", the small characters above the title are "Theatre アニメーション影视", and the large luminous main title is in the center below.{argument name="film title" default="エコテイクノート"} The subtitle is below the title.{argument name="subtitle text" default="— A choice for the future —"} Below the title are three award laurel wreaths displayed horizontally, containing a small Japanese film festival text. At the very bottom is a dense Japanese cast and crew list, with minimal social media and website information. The release date is prominently displayed in the lower right corner.{argument name="release date" default="8.22 FRI"} Below this is a smaller line of text: "National Roadshow". A museum-quality, high-resolution photograph showcases a traditional Chinese calligraphy handscroll laid flat on beige Xuan paper, filling the entire viewfinder with no visible mounting border. Slightly cold

Looking back at the desolate place I came from
Returning

templates.title: Blue ballpoint pen "Dark History" comic battle page
templates.prompt: A single hand-drawn comic strip, set against a cream-colored notebook paper, is entirely composed of rough blue ballpoint pen lines, exuding a messy, teenage doodle feel. The panel layouts are uneven, the shadows are sloppy, and the action is exaggerated, presenting a deliberately amateurish "dark history notebook" style. The page contains a total of six vertically arranged panels: one top wide panel, one second wide panel, one third wide panel, one narrow horizontal impact panel, and two smaller panels side-by-side at the bottom. In the first panel at the top, a round, pink, spherical, cute hero is dramatically crouching on the left, a long sword stuck behind him, his eyes fierce; on the right stands a curly-haired man in a shirt, tie, and trousers, looking like a thug or office worker, hands in his pockets, against a desolate rocky plain with sloppy clouds and speed lines. In the second panel, a chubby swordsman leaps diagonally into the air, surrounded by vertical lines of motion; the panel is filled with huge handwritten Japanese onomatopoeia, in two sets: "断タネ" on the left and "超時空" on the right. In the third panel, the hero flies low from left to right, unleashing a sharp energy slash or screaming attack at the man on the right; the panel is spanned by a huge handwritten Japanese shout: "ズギャアアアン!!!". In the fourth narrow panel, the entire scene is filled with the chaos of smoke, impact graffiti, and explosions, accompanied by a huge handwritten Japanese sound effect: "ドォォォン!!!". In the fifth panel in the lower left corner, the smoke dissipates, revealing the man unharmed, casually using two fingers to catch or block the small sword near his face; next to his fingers is a tiny handwritten note: "ピタ…". In the sixth panel at the bottom right, a close-up of the chubby hero appears, screaming in terror, eyes wide open, sweating profusely, with dark striped shadows on his face; to the right is a line of vertical handwritten Japanese reaction: “Naka!?”. Please obscure the faces of human characters with soft rectangular blur blocks. Overall tone: a comical and over-the-top parody of a battle manga, middle school notebook doodles, chaotic composition, monochrome blue ink pen sketches, no sophisticated digital rendering, retaining visible doodle marks and imperfect anatomical structures.

He wears a loose-fitting dark indigo hoodie and black trousers, clutching a ranking list tightly to his chest. The list prominently displays "11th Place" at the top, followed by a vertically arranged list of rankings, with the bottom line reading "11th Place: Kamishiro Touma." He appears both embarrassed and frustrated, with beads of sweat on his face and four vertical blue pressure symbols above his head. Behind him stands a cheerful young woman with medium-length chestnut brown wavy hair adorned with a white flower hair clip, wearing a beige ribbed sweater, gently smiling and placing a hand on his shoulder. Her name tag reads "Suzume and Sori." Her speech bubble reads "トウマくん、ドンマイだよ~! 时はきっとツイてるよ♡". Sitting on the left is a young man with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt, leaning forward with a hand close to his face, giving support; his speech bubble reads "contentは悪くなかったよ. オーラスの気 citedきもよかったし.". To the right sat a young woman in a dark suit jacket over a white shirt, with neat brown hair tied back. She gently touched the boy's shoulder and spoke calmly; her speech bubble read, "The result is important. I hope you can make it this far." A small murmured speech bubble was added near the boy, reading "Uh...". Hanging in the upper left corner was a wooden plaque decorated with cherry blossoms, which read, "Sponge and Sou, please!" On the wall in the upper right corner hung a framed scoreboard titled "Today's Mahjong Results," listing four rows of dotted blank lines for 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th place, with the last line reading "11th place, Touma Kamishiro." The foreground shows a green mahjong table with rows of tiles, including a standing "中" (zhong) tile, a small wooden plaque marked "ドラ" (dora), and a ceramic cup inscribed with the characters "雀和薘" (juku wa sō). (Management wo motto, Kuaisu ni.) and a smaller gray subheading "无制限登录・分析・広告なしのProプラン" (Unlimited Login, Analysis, and Advertisements). Below this, display three small, rounded function labels side-by-side: a white label with a green dot for "无制限" (Unlimited), a white label with a yellow dot for "分析" (Analysis), and a white label with a red dot for "広告なし" (Advertisements). Below is a rounded white contrast card with 3 function rows and 3 column titles: "機能", "Free", and "Pro". Below this is a smaller black formula: "= ¥200 off with coupon + ¥1500 off with group purchase + Gift worth ¥730." Below this is a full-width blue section labeled "Money-Saving Guide." Below this, a three-column money-saving guide is constructed, containing three numbered panels: Panel 1 has a blue corner mark "1" with the text "Get a coupon for an instant discount of ¥200", a blue button-like strip "Scan to get a coupon", smaller text below "Get the coupon first, then join the group purchase", and a black and white QR code; Panel 2 has a yellow corner mark "2" with the text "Join the group purchase and get an additional ¥1500 off", and a small book or magazine cover thumbnail at the bottom; Panel 3 has a red corner mark "3" with the text "Get a ¥730 exclusive gift upon forming a group", smaller text below "AI Insider 1 Year (¥365)" and "Physical Gift Pack (¥365)", and two small gift thumbnails at the bottom. A white strip is added below the three columns with bold black text: "An average of ¥3.55 per day, unlocking the whole family's AI learning power!" In the lower middle section, on the left, there are two host/personal profile blocks: the first displays a square avatar, the blue name "howie", and the black text "Navigator" plus "Equipping AI with New Skills" and "Demanding Value from AI Systems"; the second displays a square avatar, the orange-red name "savage", and the black text "Take You" plus "Cultivating Intrinsic Motivation" and "Building a Learning Family Together". Near the bottom, a yellow panel is added on the left, containing a waving, all-black cartoon bear mascot. A striking blue call to action, "Scan the code to join a group purchase now," is placed in the center of the bottom, with a black decorative line and the subtitle "Lock in the initial price" below. A large black and white QR code is placed in the lower right corner. Finally, the bottom bar is divided into two colored areas: the blue area on the left features a white shield icon and the white text "Price Guarantee: 180-day price drop refund"; the red area on the right features a white card/payment icon and the white text "Easy Payment: Alipay 12-month interest-free installments". templates.title: Q-version cat-eared maid crayon drawing scene

She has oversized cat ears, a lace maid headband, and twin tails, her hair a bright pastel color scheme of pink, blue, yellow, and orange. She has large, cyan-blue eyes, her expression focused and calm. She wears a black and white maid outfit, decorated with bows, lace, puff sleeves, fluffy cuffs, and delicate hair clips. She holds a blue crayon, drawing a simple crayon figure in the sketchbook. Scattered around her are crayon scribbles and loose pieces of paper on the table or floor. The illustration must include six clearly visible crayons of different colors; avoid showing conspicuous crayon boxes. To the left is a small cardboard box containing a sleepy black cat curled up among the crayons, next to a simple cat face drawing. In the lower left foreground, a white toy robot cat with blue accents sits and watches. In the upper right background, two children's drawings are hung, clipped to a rope: one depicts a pink heart, the other flowers and a rainbow. A large line of handwritten Japanese crayon text is added to the upper left corner: "完璧じゃなくていーんだよ！ だって、今日のわたしはがんばったもん！", written in colored crayon strokes. The overall lighting is soft, creating a comfortable craft room atmosphere, with a delicate grain and deliberately rough crayon texture. templates.title: The bewildered elf girl at her desk
templates.prompt: A cute pastel anime illustration depicts a young, fairy-like female news anchor or office worker, sitting at her desk typing on a mechanical keyboard in a cozy bedroom workspace. The image is presented from a front-side perspective, with a large black computer monitor partially obscuring her figure in the foreground to the left. She has long, wavy hair, and her hair color is {argument name="hair color" default="orange color"} She has glossy, pointed elf ears and a small red flower hair clip on her right side. She wears a light blue pajama-style shirt with red heart patterns, delicate white lace trim at the collar, and a sparkling red bow around her neck. Her hands are on the keyboard, her nails painted a soft pink, and she sits in a round pink office chair. Above her head is a speech bubble with a large question mark inside, suggesting she's feeling confused while working at the computer. The room has a soft, bright, and girlish atmosphere, using light pink and cream tones with a shallow depth of field and delicate lines. The background includes: a framed picture on the wall with pink animals and heart patterns; a small potted plant near the left; a plush toy on the shelf behind her; and two sticky notes on the upper right wall, one with a plus sign and the other with {argument name="note text" default="がんばろう!"} A blue cat figurine or plush toy on the right shelf; a small potted plant on the right; four pastel binders or books on the bottom right shelf; and a white mug with a pink heart on the bottom right table. The computer monitor should have a subtle blue glowing heart icon on the back, and the keyboard should have RGB backlighting. Clean and refined cel-shaded anime style, high detail, soft ambient lighting, a warm gaming table atmosphere, cute pastel decorations, and 4K illustrations.

Their faces were deliberately obscured by soft, rectangular mosaics, much like the anonymization of social media posts, but their hairstyles, clothing, postures, and the setting remained clear. They wore coordinated, feminine stage uniforms in shades of dusty rose and beige, with white bows at the necklines, floral lace embellishments on the shoulders and chest, puff sleeves, gold buttons, and small black lapel microphones clipped near the collar. The center woman had a shoulder-length light brown bob with side-swept bangs; two taller women behind and to the right had long, dark brown curly hair; only the heads of two other members were visible in the lower left and right corners. The studio backdrop was rich and varied in color: beige and soft-toned brick walls, a stylized tree cutout in the upper left corner, a glowing purple LED panel on the left surrounded by a decorative pink ornate border with white flower icons, and geometric, soft-toned wall panels on the right. templates.title: Candy-themed Lunar New Year Shrine
templates.prompt: This ultra-dense, maximalist fantasy illustration, employing a perfectly symmetrical frontal composition, depicts a candy-themed Lunar New Year shrine scene, rich in color and detail. At the center, a kawaii, doll-like goddess sits cross-legged atop a pile of candy, her posture serene like a lotus flower. Behind her is a massive radiating mandala halo, composed of layered lotus petals and decorative festive patterns in shades of gold, pink, orange, cyan, and neon rainbow. She sports a glossy, dark brown bob with a purple sheen and bangs; her face is porcelain-like, with rosy lips, and her eyes are veiled by a yellow and black warning stripe-like visor or eye patch. Her hair is adorned with oversized candy beads and lollipops, and she wears an extravagantly sculptural gown composed of frosting, sugar needles, bows, hearts, candy pendants, pastel mascot heads, and dripping candy textures. The upper half contains six striking red and gold circular festive signs inscribed with Chinese characters such as "福" (fortune), "旺" (prosperity), "喜" (happiness), and "吉" (good fortune). Style: Ultra-high detail, glossy 3D digital art, candy style, pop surrealism, toy-like 3D models, festive altars, Lunar New Year imagery, saturated reds, pinks, oranges and golds, shimmering highlights, sharp focus, intricate textures, full of a festive and sacred atmosphere.

templates.title: Cute Chinese word segmentation infographic
templates.prompt: This is an adorable horizontal, hand-drawn scrapbook-style Chinese science infographic. The background is warm beige paper with rounded borders, macaron-colored doodles, washi tape stickers, and little stars, creating a classroom notebook atmosphere. At the top center is a striking handwritten Chinese title: "What is Tokenization?", with the latter half in coral pink and the rest in dark brown. In the upper left corner is a cute Shiba Inu teacher character, wearing a light yellow shirt and blue tie, facing forward, holding a pointer upwards, with a speech bubble next to him saying: "Today we'll learn about tokenization!" In the upper right corner is a cute blue square Token mascot, labeled "TOKEN," smiling with rosy cheeks, tiny limbs, and holding a magnifying glass; next to it is a speech bubble saying: "I am a Token! The more rationally it's segmented, the smarter the model!" Near the right edge, a small hanging note card is added, saying "Knowledge Points Collection" and accompanied by a heart icon. Below the title, a rounded dotted text box contains the definition: "Tokenization is the process of dividing human-readable text into tokens." The word "Token" is highlighted in blue. Below that, a line of explanatory text is added: "Let's take 'Programmer Left' and 'Artificial Intelligence' as examples to see different tokenization methods:" "Programmer Left" is highlighted in light blue, and "Artificial Intelligence" in pink. The lower half contains four rounded, pastel-colored panels arranged from left to right, each with a numbered badge and title. Panel 1 is mint green, titled "1-Word-Level Tokenization," with the subtitle "Segmenting Text Based on Complete Semantics," and contains three token bubbles: "Programmer," "Left," and "Artificial Intelligence." At the bottom of this panel, a Shiba Inu teacher gives a thumbs-up, with a speech bubble that reads: "Semantic complete, easy to understand!" Panel 2 is light yellow, titled "2-Character Level Token Segmentation" with the subtitle "Character-by-Character Text Segmentation." It contains nine circular token bubbles arranged in a row: "程" (program), "序" (sequence), "员" (person), "L" (L), "e" (e), "f" (f), "t" (t), "人" (person), "工" (work), "智" (intelligence), and "能" (ability)—presenting individual characters in the example in a compact grid. At the bottom, a blue token mascot holds a pencil, with a speech bubble that reads: "Fineest granularity, but the sequences will be very long~." Panel 3 is light pink, titled "3-Sub-Word Segmentation" with the subtitle "Segmentation by Root and Prefix/Suffix." It contains five token bubbles: "程序" (program), "员" (person), "Left," "人工" (artificial), and "智能" (intelligence). At the bottom, a Shiba Inu teacher is shown thinking, with a paw near its mouth and a question mark above its head. The speech bubble reads: "Compromise solution, often works very well!" Panel 4 is light blue, titled "4-Byte Level Word Segmentation," with the subtitle "Converting Words to Byte Encoding, Combining and Dividing Based on the Conversion." It displays 14 small circular code bubbles: "E7," "A8," "8B," "...", "66," "74," "E4," "BA," "BA," "E8," "83," "BD," "..." arranged in multiple rows like encoded bytes. At the bottom, a smiling blue Token mascot is displayed again, with a speech bubble that reads, "Suitable for processing any text!" Next to it is a tiny light bulb doodle. At the very bottom, a rounded banner notes, "Different word segmentation methods have their advantages; in actual applications, the appropriate solution will be chosen based on the task and data!" All four panels use soft macaron green, yellow, pink, and blue, paired with dark brown handwritten font, delicate shadows, rounded shapes, and cute expressions. The overall composition is balanced, simple, and user-friendly, like a beautifully designed social media science poster.

templates.title: Scrapbook Byte-level BPE Principle Analysis
templates.prompt: A charming horizontal educational infographic, presented in a hand-drawn scrapbook style with a soft background of desktop and paper collages, aims to explain the principles of Chinese word segmentation based on byte-level BPE. The image is divided into three clearly defined teaching areas, spanning the entire wide banner from left to right. A cute Shiba Inu mascot stands on the far left.{argument name="character name" default="Chai Xiaoqi"} With warm brown and cream fur, a round face, small triangular ears, rosy cheeks, and a curious expression, it stands beside a desk with drawers, a pencil, and a chair, holding a cup in its hand. Above the Shiba Inu is a bold, rounded white title box containing black Chinese characters:{argument name="headline text" default="Chinese word segmentation: Byte-level BPE (BBPE) process popular science"} In the first teaching area near the top, four translucent blue token-shaped cubes are displayed on a wooden shelf. Each cube is labeled "Token" and accompanied by a curved arrow and a handwritten Chinese annotation, "Word Frequency Corpus Statistics," pointing to the next step. In the second area, a large magnifying glass highlights three frequency cubes labeled "E7," "94," and "B5." The area label is written on a yellow sticky note, stating "2. Frequency Statistics and Merging." Below and inside the magnified area is a large black Chinese character "电" (electricity), next to which is a handwritten annotation, "Frequent Byte Pairs." In the lower center of the third area, a wooden sign and a larger merged translucent blue token cube are added, labeled "Token," and accompanied by a yellow sticky note stating "3. Cross-Word Merging," with the large black Chinese characters "我们→" (we →), and below it is an explanatory note, "High-frequency words are combined and merged into tokens." On the far right, the final explanation is displayed: three small byte squares labeled "E7," "94," and "B5" sit above a large black Chinese character for "electricity," next to a note that reads "1. Byte-level encoding (UTF-8)," and below is a large black Chinese word for "we." Pink, blue, and green curved arrows connect the various areas to illustrate the flow. Near the bottom center is a blue token mascot with tiny limbs, a smiling face, and a wave. The design uses soft cream, pink, beige, and light blue, with thick, clear lines, sticker-like cutouts, washi tape corners, notebook textures, scattered pencil edges, and a friendly, journal-style illustration style suitable for educational charts.

templates.title: Infographic about Chinese cooking
templates.prompt: A retro-style hand-drawn Chinese infographic, printed on off-white textured paper with a torn edge, uses a two-tone printing of deep purple and bright cyan, combined with halftone shading and poster-like cartoon lines. The image contrasts intuitive, hand-crafted cooking with tool-assisted cooking and cognitive externalization. On the left, an adult chef in an apron is dramatically stirring a wok, accompanied by flames, splattering ingredients, swirling smoke, and dynamic lines of motion; the chef's face is obscured by a rectangular blur. Above his head is a glowing, brain-shaped thought bubble containing three small icons: a spice bottle, a flame, and a timer/clock, radiating light outwards. In the lower left corner, a broken chain hangs next to the prominent Chinese characters “全凭手感” (all by feel). Below the chef, a small figure is confusedly stirring a bowl, looking anxious, surrounded by exactly four question marks. In the center of the image, multiple thick arrows point from the chef's intuition to a structured cooking workflow. Above, in the center, are the prominent Chinese characters “抄着做” (do as instructed). Below, a hand holds a smartphone with clear Chinese text displayed on the screen, including "5 grams of salt" and "3 minutes over medium heat," and a finger is tapping the screen. Around the phone are measuring tools and ingredients: two measuring spoons, one measuring cup, one electronic scale, and six neatly arranged small bowls. Next to it is a steaming pot and a finished dish. Beside the finished dish is the Chinese text "7/8" and a 5-star rating, with four solid stars and one hollow star. To the right is a concept diagram of cognitive externalization, showing a smiling stick figure chef standing behind a table. The node network is connected by cyan lines and contains exactly six tool/information nodes: a smart oven at the top, two packets of seasoning labeled "seasoning packet" and "sauce packet" respectively, a clipboard labeled "precise recipe," a blender, a rice cooker, and a recipe note. At the center of the network is the prominent Chinese characters "Cognitive Externalization." On the table in front of the stick figure are exactly five plates/bowls of prepared food. At the bottom is a simplified cognitive formula: a brain icon pointing to a smaller brain icon, followed by a set of external tools/documents (including a phone screen, a microwave-like device, and three paper/manual items), then an equal sign, and finally a silhouette of a muscular human with gears inside a torso and an upward arrow near the shoulder. Below or next to this formula is the bold Chinese text "Brain + External Tools = Greater Abilities," with the first character "Brain" also displayed separately below the brain icon on the left. Using expressive sketched arrows, doodle lightning bolts, cartoonish emphasis symbols, and a balanced left-to-right flow, the design visually conveys the shift from pure intuition to a repeatable system and enhanced capabilities.
